84! NOTE ON ELEMENT ORIENTATION
85!
86! Element orientation: index V(i,j)
87!
88! (1,np) NWEST (np,np) NEAST
89!
90! (1,1) SWEST (np,1) SEAST
91!
92!
93! for the edge neighbors:
94! we set the "reverse" flag if two elements who share an edge use a
95! reverse orientation. The data is reversed during the *pack* stage
96! For corner neighbors:
97! for edge buffers, there is no orientation because two corner neighbors
98! only share a single point.
99! For ghost cell data, there is a again two posible orientations. For
100! this case, we set the "reverse" flag if the corner element is using
101! the reverse orientation. In this case, the data is reversed during the
102! *unpack* stage (not sure why)
103!
104! The edge orientation is set at startup. The corner orientation is computed
105! at run time, via the call to compute_ghost_corner_orientation()
106! This routine only works for meshes with at most 1 corner element. It's
107! not called and the corner orientation flag is not set for unstructured meshes
108
109
110!
111!
112! Mark Taylor
113! pack/unpack full element of data of size (nx,nx)
114! user specifies the size when creating the buffer
115! input/output arrays are cartesian, and will only unpack 1 corner element
116! (even if there are more when running with an unstructured grid)
117! This routine is used mostly for testing and to compute the orientation of
118! an elements corner neighbors
119!
120 public :: initGhostBuffer3D ! init/free buffers used by pack/unpack full and 3D
121 public :: FreeGhostBuffer3D
122 public :: ghostVpackfull
123 public :: ghostVunpackfull
124 ! same as above, except orientation of element data is preserved
125 ! (so boundary data for two adjacent element may not match up)
126 public :: ghostVpack_unoriented
127 public :: ghostVunpack_unoriented
128
129
130!
131! James Overfelt
132! pack/unpack user specifed halo region "nhc".
133! Does not include element edge data (assumes element edge data is C0)
134! (appropriate for continuous GLL data where the edge data does not need to be sent)
135! support for unstructed meshes via extra output arrays: sw,se,ne,nw
136! This routine is currently used by surfaces_mod.F90 to construct the GLL dual grid
137!
138 public :: ghostVpack3d ! pack/unpack specifed halo size (up to 1 element)
139 ! should be identical to ghostVpack2d except for
140 ! shape of input array
141 public :: ghostVunpack3d ! returns v including populating halo region of v
142 ! "extra" corner elements are returned in arrays
143 ! sw,se,ne,nw
144! MT TODO: this routine works for unstructed data (where the corner orientation flag is
145! not set). So why dont we remove all the "reverse" checks in unpack?
146
147
148
149
150!
151! Christoph Erath
152! pack/unpack partial element of data of size (nx,nx) with user specifed halo size nh
153! user specifies the sizes when creating the buffer
154! buffer has 1 extra dimension (as compared to subroutines above) for multiple tracers
155! input/output arrays are cartesian, and thus assume at most 1 element at each corner
156! hence currently only supports cube-sphere grids.

163 public :: FreeGhostBufferTR ! ghostbufferTR_t

601 !
602 ! communicate the get displacements
603 !
60400 do icycle=1,nSendCycles
60500 pCycle => pSchedule%SendCycle(icycle)
606 dest = pCycle%dest - 1
607 length = 1
608 tag = 2017
60900 call MPI_Isend(edge%sdisplsFull(icycle),length,MPIinteger_t,dest,tag,par%comm,edge%Srequest(icycle),ierr)
610 enddo
61100 do icycle=1,nRecvCycles
61200 pCycle => pSchedule%RecvCycle(icycle)
613 source = pCycle%source - 1
614 length = 1
615 tag = 2017
61600 call MPI_Irecv(edge%getDisplsFull(icycle),length,MPIinteger_t,source,tag,par%comm,edge%Rrequest(icycle),ierr)
617 enddo
61800 if (nRecvCycles>0) call MPI_Waitall(nSendCycles,edge%Srequest,edge%status,ierr)
61900 if (nSendCycles>0) call MPI_Waitall(nRecvCycles,edge%Rrequest,edge%status,ierr)
620 endif
621
622! print *,'RANK: ',par%rank, ' sdisplsFull: ',edge%sdisplsFull
623! print *,'RANK: ',par%rank, ' rdisplsFull: ',edge%rdisplsFull
624! print *,'RANK: ',par%rank, ' destFull: ',Schedule(1)%destFull
625! print *,'RANK: ',par%rank, ' srcFull: ',Schedule(1)%srcFull
626
62771687168 if(Debug) write(*,21) par%rank, ' sdisplsFull: ',edge%sdisplsFull
62871687168 if(Debug) write(*,21) par%rank, ' rdisplsFull: ',edge%rdisplsFull
62971687168 if(Debug) write(*,21) par%rank, ' destFull: ',Schedule(1)%destFull
63071687168 if(Debug) write(*,21) par%rank, ' srcFull: ',Schedule(1)%srcFull
631
632
633 if(edge%bndry_type == HME_BNDRY_PUT1 .or. &
634 edge%bndry_type == HME_BNDRY_PUT2 ) then
635 ! setup the main one-sided window
63600 call MPI_TYPE_SIZE(MPIreal_t,sizeofreal,ierr)
63700 winSize = INT(sizeofreal*edge%nbuf,kind=long_kind)
63800 call MPI_Win_Create(edge%receive,winSize,sizeofreal,MPI_INFO_NULL,par%comm,edge%win,ierr)
63900 if(ierr .ne. MPI_SUCCESS) then
64000 errorcode=ierr
64100 call MPI_Error_String(errorcode,errorstring,errorlen,ierr)
64200 print *,subname,': Error after call to MPI_Win_Create: ',errorstring
643 endif
644
64500 call MPI_Barrier(par%comm,ierr)
646 !
647 !
648 ! communicate the put displacements
649 !
65000 do icycle=1,nRecvCycles
65100 pCycle => pSchedule%RecvCycle(icycle)
652 source = pCycle%source - 1
653 length = 1
654 tag = 2018
65500 call MPI_Isend(edge%rdisplsFull(icycle),length,MPIinteger_t,source,tag,par%comm,edge%Srequest(icycle),ierr)
656 enddo
65700 do icycle=1,nSendCycles
65800 pCycle => pSchedule%SendCycle(icycle)
659 dest = pCycle%dest - 1
660 length = 1
661 tag = 2018
66200 call MPI_Irecv(edge%putDisplsFull(icycle),length,MPIinteger_t,dest,tag,par%comm,edge%Rrequest(icycle),ierr)
663 enddo
66400 if (nSendCycles>0) call MPI_Waitall(nSendCycles,edge%Srequest,edge%status,ierr)
66500 if (nRecvCycles>0) call MPI_Waitall(nRecvCycles,edge%Rrequest,edge%status,ierr)
666 endif
667
66871687168 if(Debug) write(*,21) par%rank,' Get Displacements: ',edge%getDisplsFull(:)
669! print *,'RANK: ',par%rank,' Get Displacements: ',edge%getDisplsFull(:)
670! print *,'RANK: ',par%rank,' Put Displacements: ',edge%putDisplsFull(:)
67171687168 if(Debug) write(*,21) par%rank,' Put Displacements: ',edge%putDisplsFull(:)
672! stop 'End of initEdgeBuffer_r8 subroutine'
673
67421 format('RANK: ',i8, A,8(i8))
675
676!$OMP END MASTER
677! MT: This next barrier is also needed - threads cannot start using edge()
678! until MASTER is done initializing it
679!$OMP BARRIER
680
681! call t_adj_detailf(-3)
682
683
684
6857168107520 end subroutine initEdgeBuffer_r8

687383544383544 integer function CalcSegmentLength(pgIndx,mPattern,nlyr) result(len)
688
689 type(pgindex_t) :: pgIndx
690 integer, intent(in) :: mPattern
691 integer, intent(in) :: nlyr
692
693 integer :: rem
694 integer, parameter :: alignment=1 ! align on word boundaries
695! integer, parameter :: alignment=2 ! align on 2 word boundaries
696! integer, parameter :: alignment=8 ! align on 8 word boundaries
697
698
699383544383544 select case(mPattern)
700 CASE(HME_MPATTERN_S)
7012739627396 len = nlyr*pgIndx%lenS
702 CASE(HME_MPATTERN_P)
703356148356148 len = nlyr*pgIndx%lenP
704 CASE DEFAULT
70500 len = nlyr*pgIndx%lenP
706 end select
707383544767088 rem = MODULO(len,alignment)
708 if(rem .ne. 0) then
70900 len = len + (alignment-rem)
710 endif
711
712
713383544383544 end function calcSegmentLength

846 ! =========================================
847 !
848 !> @brief Pack edges of v into an edge buffer for boundary exchange.
849 !
850 !> This subroutine packs for one or more vertical layers into an edge
851 !! buffer. If the buffer associated with edge is not large enough to
852 !! hold all vertical layers you intent to pack, the method will
853 !! halt the program with a call to parallel_mod::haltmp().
854 !! @param[in] edge Edge Buffer into which the data will be packed.
855 !! This buffer must be previously allocated with initEdgeBuffer().
856 !! @param[in] v The data to be packed.
857 !! @param[in] vlyr Number of vertical level coming into the subroutine
858 !! for packing for input v.
859 !! @param[in] kptr Vertical pointer to the place in the edge buffer where
860 !! data will be located.
861 ! =========================================
8626346598463465984 subroutine edgeVpack(edge,v,vlyr,kptr,ielem)
863 use dimensions_mod, only : np, max_corner_elem
864 use control_mod, only : north, south, east, west, neast, nwest, seast, swest
865
866 type (EdgeBuffer_t) :: edge
867 integer, intent(in) :: vlyr
868 real (kind=real_kind),intent(in) :: v(np,np,vlyr)
869 integer, intent(in) :: kptr
870 integer, intent(in) :: ielem
871! type (EdgeDescriptor_t),intent(in) :: desc
872
873 ! Local variables
874 integer :: i,k,ir,ll,iptr
875
876 integer :: is,ie,in,iw,edgeptr
877
878
879 is = edge%putmap(south,ielem)
880 ie = edge%putmap(east,ielem)
881 in = edge%putmap(north,ielem)
882 iw = edge%putmap(west,ielem)
883 if (edge%nlyr < (kptr+vlyr) ) then
88400 print *,'edge%nlyr = ',edge%nlyr
88500 print *,'kptr+vlyr = ',kptr+vlyr
88600 call haltmp('edgeVpack: Buffer overflow: size of the vertical dimension must be increased!')
887 endif
888!JMD call t_adj_detailf(+2)
889!dir$ ivdep
89020837698562147235840 do k=1,vlyr
89120837698562083769856 iptr = np*(kptr+k-1)
89220837698562083769856!DIR$ UNROLL(NP)
893833507942410418849280 do i=1,np
894 edge%buf(iptr+ie+i) = v(np ,i ,k) ! East
895 edge%buf(iptr+is+i) = v(i ,1 ,k) ! South
896 edge%buf(iptr+in+i) = v(i ,np,k) ! North
897 edge%buf(iptr+iw+i) = v(1 ,i ,k) ! West
898 enddo
899 enddo
900
901 ! This is really kludgy way to setup the index reversals
902 ! But since it is so a rare event not real need to spend time optimizing
903
9046346598463465984 if(edge%reverse(south,ielem)) then
9056511780867101120 do k=1,vlyr
9066511780865117808 iptr = np*(kptr+k-1)+is
907260471232260471232 do i=1,np
908 ir = np-i+1
909 edge%buf(iptr+ir)=v(i,1,k)
910 enddo
911 enddo
912 endif
913
9146346598463465984 if(edge%reverse(east,ielem)) then
9152170593622367040 do k=1,vlyr
9162170593621705936 iptr=np*(kptr+k-1)+ie
9178682374486823744 do i=1,np
918 ir = np-i+1
919 edge%buf(iptr+ir)=v(np,i,k)
920 enddo
921 enddo
922 endif
923
9246346598463465984 if(edge%reverse(north,ielem)) then
9256511780867101120 do k=1,vlyr
9266511780865117808 iptr=np*(kptr+k-1)+in
927260471232260471232 do i=1,np
928 ir = np-i+1
929 edge%buf(iptr+ir)=v(i,np,k)
930 enddo
931 enddo
932 endif
933
9346346598463465984 if(edge%reverse(west,ielem)) then
9352170593622367040 do k=1,vlyr
9362170593621705936 iptr=np*(kptr+k-1)+iw
9378682374486823744 do i=1,np
938 ir = np-i+1
939 edge%buf(iptr+ir)=v(1,i,k)
940 enddo
941 enddo
942 endif
943
944! SWEST
94563465984126931968 do ll=swest,swest+max_corner_elem-1
9466346598463465984 if (edge%putmap(ll,ielem) /= -1) then
9476321807063218070 edgeptr = edge%putmap(ll,ielem)+1
94820756301302075630130 do k=1,vlyr
94920756301302075630130 iptr = (kptr+k-1)+edgeptr
950 if (iptr > size(edge%buf)) then
95100 write(6, *) 'ERROR SW: ',size(edge%buf),iptr,edge%putmap(ll,ielem)
95200 call abortmp('pointer bounds ERROR SW')
953 end if
954 edge%buf(iptr) = v(1, 1, k)
955 end do
956 end if
957 end do
958
959! SEAST
96063465984126931968 do ll=swest+max_corner_elem,swest+2*max_corner_elem-1
9616346598463465984 if (edge%putmap(ll,ielem) /= -1) then
9626321807063218070 edgeptr = edge%putmap(ll,ielem)+1
96320756301302075630130 do k=1,vlyr
96420756301302075630130 iptr = (kptr+k-1)+edgeptr
965 if (iptr > size(edge%buf)) then
96600 write(6, *) 'ERROR SE: ',size(edge%buf),iptr,edge%putmap(ll,ielem)
96700 call abortmp('pointer bounds ERROR SE')
968 end if
969 edge%buf(iptr)=v(np, 1, k)
970 end do
971 end if
972 end do
973
974! NEAST
97563465984126931968 do ll=swest+3*max_corner_elem,swest+4*max_corner_elem-1
9766346598463465984 if (edge%putmap(ll,ielem) /= -1) then
9776321807063218070 edgeptr = edge%putmap(ll,ielem)+1
97820756301302075630130 do k=1,vlyr
97920756301302075630130 iptr = (kptr+k-1)+edgeptr
980 if (iptr > size(edge%buf)) then
98100 write(6, *) 'ERROR NE: ',size(edge%buf),iptr,edge%putmap(ll,ielem)
98200 call abortmp('pointer bounds ERROR NE')
983 end if
984 edge%buf(iptr) = v(np, np, k)
985 end do
986 end if
987 end do
988
989! NWEST
99063465984126931968 do ll=swest+2*max_corner_elem,swest+3*max_corner_elem-1
9916346598463465984 if (edge%putmap(ll,ielem) /= -1) then
9926321807063218070 edgeptr = edge%putmap(ll,ielem)+1
99320756301302075630130 do k=1,vlyr
99420756301302075630130 iptr = (kptr+k-1)+edgeptr
995 if (iptr > size(edge%buf)) then
99600 write(6, *) 'ERROR NW: ',size(edge%buf),iptr,edge%putmap(ll,ielem)
99700 call abortmp('pointer bounds ERROR NW')
998 end if
999 edge%buf(iptr) = v(1, np, k)
1000 end do
1001 end if
1002 end do
1003
1004!JMD call t_adj_detailf(-2)
1005
10066346598463465984 end subroutine edgeVpack

109230723072 subroutine LongEdgeVpack(edge,v,vlyr,kptr,desc)
1093 use control_mod, only : north, south, east, west, neast, nwest, seast, swest
1094 use dimensions_mod, only : np, max_corner_elem
1095
1096 type (LongEdgeBuffer_t) :: edge
1097 integer, intent(in) :: vlyr

1099 integer, intent(in) :: kptr

1101
1102 ! Local variables
1103 logical, parameter :: UseUnroll = .TRUE.
1104
1105 integer :: i,k,ir,l
1106
1107 integer :: is,ie,in,iw
1108
1109 if(.not. threadsafe) then
1110!$OMP BARRIER
1111512512 threadsafe=.true.
1112 end if
1113
111430723072 is = desc%putmapP(south)
1115 ie = desc%putmapP(east)
1116 in = desc%putmapP(north)
1117 iw = desc%putmapP(west)
1118
111930723072 if(MODULO(np,2) == 0 .and. UseUnroll) then
112030726144 do k=1,vlyr
112161449216 do i=1,np,2
1122 edge%buf(kptr+k,is+i) = v(i ,1 ,k)
1123 edge%buf(kptr+k,is+i+1) = v(i+1,1 ,k)
1124 edge%buf(kptr+k,ie+i) = v(np ,i ,k)
1125 edge%buf(kptr+k,ie+i+1) = v(np ,i+1 ,k)
1126 edge%buf(kptr+k,in+i) = v(i ,np,k)
1127 edge%buf(kptr+k,in+i+1) = v(i+1 ,np,k)
1128 edge%buf(kptr+k,iw+i) = v(1 ,i ,k)
1129 edge%buf(kptr+k,iw+i+1) = v(1 ,i+1 ,k)
1130
1131 enddo
1132 end do
1133 else
113400 do k=1,vlyr
113500 do i=1,np
1136 edge%buf(kptr+k,is+i) = v(i ,1 ,k)
1137 edge%buf(kptr+k,ie+i) = v(np ,i ,k)
1138 edge%buf(kptr+k,in+i) = v(i ,np,k)
1139 edge%buf(kptr+k,iw+i) = v(1 ,i ,k)
1140 enddo
1141 end do
1142
1143 endif
1144
1145
1146 ! This is really kludgy way to setup the index reversals
1147 ! But since it is so a rare event not real need to spend time optimizing
1148
114930723072 if(desc%reverse(south)) then
11509696 is = desc%putmapP(south)
11519696 do k=1,vlyr
1152384480 do i=1,np
1153 ir = np-i+1
1154 edge%buf(kptr+k,is+ir)=v(i,1,k)
1155 enddo
1156 enddo
1157 endif
1158
115930723072 if(desc%reverse(east)) then
11603232 ie = desc%putmapP(east)
11613232 do k=1,vlyr
1162128160 do i=1,np
1163 ir = np-i+1
1164 edge%buf(kptr+k,ie+ir)=v(np,i,k)
1165 enddo
1166 enddo
1167 endif
1168
116930723072 if(desc%reverse(north)) then
11709696 in = desc%putmapP(north)
11719696 do k=1,vlyr
1172384480 do i=1,np
1173 ir = np-i+1
1174 edge%buf(kptr+k,in+ir)=v(i,np,k)
1175 enddo
1176 enddo
1177 endif
1178
117930723072 if(desc%reverse(west)) then
11803232 iw = desc%putmapP(west)
11813232 do k=1,vlyr
1182128160 do i=1,np
1183 ir = np-i+1
1184 edge%buf(kptr+k,iw+ir)=v(1,i,k)
1185 enddo
1186 enddo
1187 endif
1188
1189! SWEST
119030726144 do l=swest,swest+max_corner_elem-1
119130723072 if (desc%putmapP(l) /= -1) then
119230606120 do k=1,vlyr
1193 edge%buf(kptr+k,desc%putmapP(l)+1)=v(1 ,1 ,k)
1194 end do
1195 end if
1196 end do
1197
1198! SEAST
119930726144 do l=swest+max_corner_elem,swest+2*max_corner_elem-1
120030723072 if (desc%putmapP(l) /= -1) then
120130606120 do k=1,vlyr
1202 edge%buf(kptr+k,desc%putmapP(l)+1)=v(np ,1 ,k)
1203 end do
1204 end if
1205 end do
1206
1207! NEAST
120830726144 do l=swest+3*max_corner_elem,swest+4*max_corner_elem-1
120930723072 if (desc%putmapP(l) /= -1) then
121030606120 do k=1,vlyr
1211 edge%buf(kptr+k,desc%putmapP(l)+1)=v(np ,np,k)
1212 end do
1213 end if
1214 end do
1215
1216! NWEST
121730726144 do l=swest+2*max_corner_elem,swest+3*max_corner_elem-1
121830723072 if (desc%putmapP(l) /= -1) then
121930606120 do k=1,vlyr
1220 edge%buf(kptr+k,desc%putmapP(l)+1)=v(1 ,np,k)
1221 end do
1222 end if
1223 end do
1224
1225
122630723072 end subroutine LongEdgeVpack

12286346598463465984 subroutine edgeVunpack(edge,v,vlyr,kptr,ielem)

1325!
1326 subroutine edgeVunpackVert(edge,v,ielem)
1327 use control_mod, only : north, south, east, west, neast, nwest, seast, swest
1328 use dimensions_mod, only : np, max_corner_elem, ne
1329 use coordinate_systems_mod, only: cartesian3D_t
1330
1331 type (EdgeBuffer_t), intent(inout) :: edge
1332 type (cartesian3D_t), intent(out) :: v(:,:,:)
1333 integer, intent(in) :: ielem
1334
1335 ! Local
1336 logical, parameter :: UseUnroll = .TRUE.
1337 integer :: i,k,l, nce
1338 integer :: is,ie,in,iw,ine,inw,isw,ise
1339
1340 threadsafe=.false.
1341
1342 if (max_corner_elem.ne.1 .and. ne==0) then
1343 ! MNL: this is used to construct the dual grid on the cube,
1344 ! currently only supported for the uniform grid. If
1345 ! this is desired on a refined grid, a little bit of
1346 ! work will be required.
1347 call haltmp("edgeVunpackVert should not be called with unstructured meshes")
1348 end if
1349
1350 is=edge%getmap(south,ielem)
1351 ie=edge%getmap(east,ielem)
1352 in=edge%getmap(north,ielem)
1353 iw=edge%getmap(west,ielem)
1354
1355
1356 ! N+S
1357 do i=1,np/2
1358 ! North
1359 ! kptr = 0
1360 ! iptr=np*(kptr+k-1)+in
1361
1362! iptr = np*(1-1)+in
1363! v(3,i ,np)%x = edge%receive(1,in+i)
1364 v(3,i ,np)%x = edge%receive(in+i)
1365
1366! iptr = np*(2-1)+in
1367! v(3,i ,np)%y = edge%receive(2,in+i)
1368 v(3,i ,np)%y = edge%receive(np+in+i)
1369
1370! iptr = np*(3-1)+in
1371! v(3,i ,np)%z = edge%receive(3,in+i)
1372 v(3,i ,np)%z = edge%receive(2*np+in+i)
1373
1374 ! South
1375 ! v(2,i ,1)%x = edge%receive(1,is+i)
1376 v(2,i ,1)%x = edge%receive(is+i)
1377
1378 ! v(2,i ,1)%y = edge%receive(2,is+i)
1379 v(2,i ,1)%y = edge%receive(np+is+i)
1380
1381 ! v(2,i ,1)%z = edge%receive(3,is+i)
1382 v(2,i ,1)%z = edge%receive(2*np+is+i)
1383 enddo
1384
1385 do i=np/2+1,np
1386 ! North
1387 ! v(4,i ,np)%x = edge%receive(1,in+i)
1388 v(4,i ,np)%x = edge%receive(in+i)
1389
1390 ! v(4,i ,np)%y = edge%receive(2,in+i)
1391 v(4,i ,np)%y = edge%receive(np+in+i)
1392
1393 ! v(4,i ,np)%z = edge%receive(3,in+i)
1394 v(4,i ,np)%z = edge%receive(2*np+in+i)
1395 ! South
1396 ! v(1,i ,1)%x = edge%receive(1,is+i)
1397 v(1,i ,1)%x = edge%receive(is+i)
1398 ! v(1,i ,1)%y = edge%receive(2,is+i)
1399 v(1,i ,1)%y = edge%receive(np+is+i)
1400 ! v(1,i ,1)%z = edge%receive(3,is+i)
1401 v(1,i ,1)%z = edge%receive(2*np+is+i)
1402 enddo
1403
1404 do i=1,np/2
1405 ! East
1406 ! v(3,np,i)%x = edge%receive(1,ie+i)
1407 v(3,np,i)%x = edge%receive(ie+i)
1408 ! v(3,np,i)%y = edge%receive(2,ie+i)
1409 v(3,np,i)%y = edge%receive(np+ie+i)
1410 ! v(3,np,i)%z = edge%receive(3,ie+i)
1411 v(3,np,i)%z = edge%receive(2*np+ie+i)
1412 ! West
1413 ! v(4,1,i)%x = edge%receive(1,iw+i)
1414 v(4,1,i)%x = edge%receive(iw+i)
1415 ! v(4,1,i)%y = edge%receive(2,iw+i)
1416 v(4,1,i)%y = edge%receive(np+iw+i)
1417 ! v(4,1,i)%z = edge%receive(3,iw+i)
1418 v(4,1,i)%z = edge%receive(2*np+iw+i)
1419 end do
1420
1421 do i=np/2+1,np
1422 ! East
1423 ! v(2,np,i)%x = edge%receive(1,ie+i)
1424 v(2,np,i)%x = edge%receive(ie+i)
1425
1426 ! v(2,np,i)%y = edge%receive(2,ie+i)
1427 v(2,np,i)%y = edge%receive(np+ie+i)
1428
1429 ! v(2,np,i)%z = edge%receive(3,ie+i)
1430 v(2,np,i)%z = edge%receive(2*np+ie+i)
1431 ! West
1432
1433 ! v(1,1,i)%x = edge%receive(1,iw+i)
1434 v(1,1,i)%x = edge%receive(iw+i)
1435
1436 ! v(1,1,i)%y = edge%receive(2,iw+i)
1437 v(1,1,i)%y = edge%receive(np+iw+i)
1438
1439 ! v(1,1,i)%z = edge%receive(3,iw+i)
1440 v(1,1,i)%z = edge%receive(2*np+iw+i)
1441 end do
1442
1443! SWEST
1444 nce = max_corner_elem
1445 do l=swest,swest+max_corner_elem-1
1446 ! find the one active corner, then exist
1447 isw=edge%getmap(l,ielem)
1448 if(isw /= -1) then
1449 ! v(1,1,1)%x=edge%receive(1,desc%getmapP(l)+1)
1450 v(1,1,1)%x=edge%receive(isw+1)
1451 ! v(1,1,1)%y=edge%receive(2,desc%getmapP(l)+1)
1452 v(1,1,1)%y=edge%receive(nce+isw+1)
1453 ! v(1,1,1)%z=edge%receive(3,desc%getmapP(l)+1)
1454 v(1,1,1)%z=edge%receive(2*nce+isw+1)
1455 exit
1456 else
1457 v(1,1,1)%x=0_real_kind
1458 v(1,1,1)%y=0_real_kind
1459 v(1,1,1)%z=0_real_kind
1460 endif
1461 end do
1462
1463! SEAST
1464 do l=swest+max_corner_elem,swest+2*max_corner_elem-1
1465 ! find the one active corner, then exist
1466 ise=edge%getmap(l,ielem)
1467 if(ise /= -1) then
1468 ! v(2,np,1)%x=edge%receive(1,desc%getmapP(l)+1)
1469 v(2,np,1)%x=edge%receive(ise+1)
1470 ! v(2,np,1)%y=edge%receive(2,desc%getmapP(l)+1)
1471 v(2,np,1)%y=edge%receive(nce+ise+1)
1472 ! v(2,np,1)%z=edge%receive(3,desc%getmapP(l)+1)
1473 v(2,np,1)%z=edge%receive(2*nce+ise+1)
1474 exit
1475 else
1476 v(2,np,1)%x=0_real_kind
1477 v(2,np,1)%y=0_real_kind
1478 v(2,np,1)%z=0_real_kind
1479 endif
1480 end do
1481
1482! NEAST
1483 do l=swest+3*max_corner_elem,swest+4*max_corner_elem-1
1484 ! find the one active corner, then exist
1485 ine=edge%getmap(l,ielem)
1486 if(ine /= -1) then
1487 v(3,np,np)%x=edge%receive(ine+1)
1488 v(3,np,np)%y=edge%receive(nce+ine+1)
1489 v(3,np,np)%z=edge%receive(2*nce+ine+1)
1490 exit
1491 else
1492 v(3,np,np)%x=0_real_kind
1493 v(3,np,np)%y=0_real_kind
1494 v(3,np,np)%z=0_real_kind
1495 endif
1496 end do
1497
1498! NWEST
1499 do l=swest+2*max_corner_elem,swest+3*max_corner_elem-1
1500 ! find the one active corner, then exist
1501 inw = edge%getmap(l,ielem)
1502 if(inw/= -1) then
1503 v(4,1,np)%x=edge%receive(inw+1)
1504 v(4,1,np)%y=edge%receive(nce+inw+1)
1505 v(4,1,np)%z=edge%receive(2*nce+inw+1)
1506 exit
1507 else
1508 v(4,1,np)%x=0_real_kind
1509 v(4,1,np)%y=0_real_kind
1510 v(4,1,np)%z=0_real_kind
1511 endif
1512 end do
1513
1514 ! Fill the missing vertex info
1515
1516 do i=2,np/2
1517 ! North
1518 v(4,i ,np)%x = v(3,i-1 ,np)%x
1519 v(4,i ,np)%y = v(3,i-1 ,np)%y
1520 v(4,i ,np)%z = v(3,i-1 ,np)%z
1521 ! South
1522 v(1,i ,1)%x = v(2,i-1 ,1)%x
1523 v(1,i ,1)%y = v(2,i-1 ,1)%y
1524 v(1,i ,1)%z = v(2,i-1 ,1)%z
1525 enddo
1526
1527 do i=np/2+1,np-1
1528 ! North
1529 v(3,i ,np)%x = v(4,i+1 ,np)%x
1530 v(3,i ,np)%y = v(4,i+1 ,np)%y
1531 v(3,i ,np)%z = v(4,i+1 ,np)%z
1532 ! South
1533 v(2,i ,1)%x = v(1,i+1 ,1)%x
1534 v(2,i ,1)%y = v(1,i+1 ,1)%y
1535 v(2,i ,1)%z = v(1,i+1 ,1)%z
1536 enddo
1537
1538 do i=2,np/2
1539 ! East
1540 v(2,np,i)%x = v(3,np,i-1)%x
1541 v(2,np,i)%y = v(3,np,i-1)%y
1542 v(2,np,i)%z = v(3,np,i-1)%z
1543 ! West
1544 v(1,1,i)%x = v(4,1,i-1)%x
1545 v(1,1,i)%y = v(4,1,i-1)%y
1546 v(1,1,i)%z = v(4,1,i-1)%z
1547 end do
1548
1549 do i=np/2+1,np-1
1550 ! East
1551 v(3,np,i)%x = v(2,np,i+1)%x
1552 v(3,np,i)%y = v(2,np,i+1)%y
1553 v(3,np,i)%z = v(2,np,i+1)%z
1554 ! West
1555 v(4,1,i)%x = v(1,1,i+1)%x
1556 v(4,1,i)%y = v(1,1,i+1)%y
1557 v(4,1,i)%z = v(1,1,i+1)%z
1558 end do
1559
1560 end subroutine edgeVunpackVert
1561 ! ========================================
1562 ! edgeDGVunpack:
1563 !
1564 ! Unpack edges from edge buffer into v...
1565 ! ========================================
1566
1567 subroutine edgeDGVunpack(edge,v,vlyr,kptr,ielem)
1568 use dimensions_mod, only : np, max_corner_elem
1569 use control_mod, only : north, south, east, west, neast, nwest, seast, swest
1570
1571 type (EdgeBuffer_t), intent(in) :: edge
1572 integer, intent(in) :: vlyr
1573 real (kind=real_kind), intent(out) :: v(0:np+1,0:np+1,vlyr)
1574 integer, intent(in) :: kptr
1575 integer, intent(in) :: ielem
1576
1577 ! Local
1578
1579 integer :: i,k,iptr
1580 integer :: is,ie,in,iw
1581
1582 threadsafe=.false.
1583
1584 is=edge%getmap(south,ielem)
1585 ie=edge%getmap(east,ielem)
1586 in=edge%getmap(north,ielem)
1587 iw=edge%getmap(west,ielem)
1588 do k=1,vlyr
1589 iptr=np*(kptr+k-1)
1590 do i=1,np
1591 v(i ,0 ,k)=edge%receive(iptr+is+i)
1592 v(np+1,i ,k)=edge%receive(iptr+ie+i)
1593 v(i ,np+1,k)=edge%receive(iptr+in+i)
1594 v(0 ,i ,k)=edge%receive(iptr+iw+i)
1595 end do
1596 end do
1597
1598 i = swest
1599 if(edge%getmap(i,ielem) /= -1) then
1600 do k=1,vlyr
1601 iptr=(kptr+k-1)
1602 v(0,0,k) = edge%receive(iptr+edge%getmap(i,ielem)+1)
1603 end do
1604 end if
1605 i = swest+max_corner_elem
1606 if(edge%getmap(i,ielem) /= -1) then
1607 do k=1,vlyr
1608 iptr=(kptr+k-1)
1609 v(np+1,0,k) = edge%receive(iptr+edge%getmap(i,ielem)+1)
1610 end do
1611 end if
1612 i = swest+3*max_corner_elem
1613 if(edge%getmap(i,ielem) /= -1) then
1614 do k=1,vlyr
1615 iptr=(kptr+k-1)
1616 v(np+1,np+1,k) = edge%receive(iptr+edge%getmap(i,ielem)+1)
1617 end do
1618 end if
1619 i = swest+2*max_corner_elem
1620 if(edge%getmap(i,ielem) /= -1) then
1621 do k=1,vlyr
1622 iptr=(kptr+k-1)
1623 v(0,np+1,k) = edge%receive(iptr+edge%getmap(i,ielem)+1)
1624 end do
1625 end if
1626
1627 end subroutine edgeDGVunpack
1628
1629 ! ========================================
1630 ! edgeVunpackMIN/MAX:
1631 !
1632 ! Finds the Min/Max edges from edge buffer into v...
1633 ! ========================================
1634 subroutine edgeVunpackMAX(edge,v,vlyr,kptr,ielem)
1635 use dimensions_mod, only : np, max_corner_elem
1636 use control_mod, only : north, south, east, west, neast, nwest, seast, swest
1637
1638 type (EdgeBuffer_t), intent(in) :: edge
1639 integer, intent(in) :: vlyr
1640 real (kind=real_kind), intent(inout) :: v(np,np,vlyr)
1641 integer, intent(in) :: kptr
1642 integer, intent(in) :: ielem
1643
1644
1645 ! Local
1646
1647 integer :: i,k,l,iptr
1648 integer :: is,ie,in,iw
1649
1650 threadsafe=.false.
1651
1652 is=edge%getmap(south,ielem)
1653 ie=edge%getmap(east,ielem)
1654 in=edge%getmap(north,ielem)
1655 iw=edge%getmap(west,ielem)
1656 do k=1,vlyr
1657 iptr=np*(kptr+k-1)
1658 do i=1,np
1659 v(np ,i ,k) = MAX(v(np ,i ,k),edge%receive(iptr+ie+i ))
1660 v(i ,1 ,k) = MAX(v(i ,1 ,k),edge%receive(iptr+is+i ))
1661 v(i ,np ,k) = MAX(v(i ,np ,k),edge%receive(iptr+in+i ))
1662 v(1 ,i ,k) = MAX(v(1 ,i ,k),edge%receive(iptr+iw+i ))
1663 end do
1664 end do
1665
1666! SWEST
1667 do l=swest,swest+max_corner_elem-1
1668 if(edge%getmap(l,ielem) /= -1) then
1669 do k=1,vlyr
1670 v(1 ,1 ,k)=MAX(v(1 ,1 ,k),edge%receive((kptr+k-1)+edge%getmap(l,ielem)+1))
1671 enddo
1672 endif
1673 end do
1674
1675! SEAST
1676 do l=swest+max_corner_elem,swest+2*max_corner_elem-1
1677 if(edge%getmap(l,ielem) /= -1) then
1678 do k=1,vlyr
1679 v(np ,1 ,k)=MAX(v(np,1 ,k),edge%receive((kptr+k-1)+edge%getmap(l,ielem)+1))
1680 enddo
1681 endif
1682 end do
1683
1684! NEAST
1685 do l=swest+3*max_corner_elem,swest+4*max_corner_elem-1
1686 if(edge%getmap(l,ielem) /= -1) then
1687 do k=1,vlyr
1688 v(np ,np,k)=MAX(v(np,np,k),edge%receive((kptr+k-1)+edge%getmap(l,ielem)+1))
1689 enddo
1690 endif
1691 end do
1692
1693! NWEST
1694 do l=swest+2*max_corner_elem,swest+3*max_corner_elem-1
1695 if(edge%getmap(l,ielem) /= -1) then
1696 do k=1,vlyr
1697 v(1 ,np,k)=MAX(v(1 ,np,k),edge%receive((kptr+k-1)+edge%getmap(l,ielem)+1))
1698 enddo
1699 endif
1700 end do
1701

1991 subroutine edgerotate(edge,vlyr,kptr,desc)
1992 use dimensions_mod, only : np
1993 type (EdgeBuffer_t) :: edge ! edge struct
1994 integer, intent(in) :: vlyr ! number of 2d vector fields to rotate
1995 integer, intent(in) :: kptr ! layer pointer into edge buffer
1996 type (EdgeDescriptor_t), intent(in) :: desc
1997
1998 ! Local variables
1999
2000 integer :: i,k,k1,k2
2001 integer :: irot,ia,nbr
2002
2003 real(kind=real_kind), dimension(:,:,:), pointer :: R
2004 real(kind=real_kind) :: tmp1,tmp2
2005
2006 print *,'entered into edgerotate... Note that this code is currently not functional'
2007 stop 'ERROR: edgerotate'
2008#ifdef _USEASSOCIATED
2009 if (associated(rot)) then
2010#else
2011 if (desc%use_rotation == 1) then
2012#endif
2013
2014 do irot=1,SIZE(desc%rot)
2015
2016 nbr = desc%rot(irot)%nbr
2017 R => desc%rot(irot)%R
2018
2019 ia=desc%putmapP(nbr)
2020
2021 ! ========================================
2022 ! If nbr direction is (1-4) => is an edge
2023 ! ========================================
2024
2025 if (nbr <= 4) then
2026
2027 ! ========================================================
2028 ! Is an edge. Rotate it in place
2029 ! ========================================================
2030
2031! do i=1,np
2032! do k=1,vlyr,2
2033! k1 = kptr + k
2034! k2 = k1 + 1
2035! tmp1=R(1,1,i)*edge%buf(k1,ia+i) + R(1,2,i)*edge%buf(k2,ia+i)
2036! tmp2=R(2,1,i)*edge%buf(k1,ia+i) + R(2,2,i)*edge%buf(k2,ia+i)
2037! edge%buf(k1,ia+i)=tmp1
2038! edge%buf(k2,ia+i)=tmp2
2039! end do
2040! end do
2041
2042 else
2043
2044 ! ===================================================
2045 ! Is an element corner point, but not a cube corner
2046 ! point, just rotate it in place.
2047 ! ===================================================
2048
2049! if (ia /= -1) then
2050! do k=1,vlyr,2
2051! k1 = kptr + k
2052! k2 = k1+1
2053! tmp1=R(1,1,1)*edge%buf(k1,ia+1) + R(1,2,1)*edge%buf(k2,ia+1)
2054! tmp2=R(2,1,1)*edge%buf(k1,ia+1) + R(2,2,1)*edge%buf(k2,ia+1)
2055! edge%buf(k1,ia+1)=tmp1
2056! edge%buf(k2,ia+1)=tmp2
2057! end do
2058! end if
2059
2060 end if
2061
2062 end do
2063
2064 endif
2065
2066 end subroutine edgerotate

2068 ! =============================================
2069 ! buffermap:
2070 !
2071 ! buffermap translates element number, inum and
2072 ! element edge/corner, facet, into an edge buffer
2073 ! memory location, loc.
2074 ! =============================================
2075
2076 function buffermap(inum,facet) result(loc)
2077 use dimensions_mod, only : np
2078 integer, intent(in) :: inum
2079 integer, intent(in) :: facet
2080 integer :: loc
2081
2082 if (facet>4) then
2083 if (inum == -1) then
2084 loc = inum
2085 else
2086 loc=(inum-1)*(4*np+4)+4*np+(facet-5)
2087 end if
2088 else
2089 loc=(inum-1)*(4*np+4)+np*(facet-1)
2090 end if
2091
2092 end function buffermap

2113 ! =========================================
2114
2115 ! =========================================
2116 !
2117 !> @brief Pack edges of v into an edge buffer for boundary exchange.
2118 !
2119 !> This subroutine packs for one or more vertical layers into an edge
2120 !! buffer. If the buffer associated with edge is not large enough to
2121 !! hold all vertical layers you intent to pack, the method will
2122 !! halt the program with a call to parallel_mod::haltmp().
2123 !! @param[in] edge Ghost Buffer into which the data will be packed.
2124 !! This buffer must be previously allocated with initghostbufferfull().
2125 !! @param[in] v The data to be packed.
2126 !! @param[in] vlyr Number of vertical level coming into the subroutine
2127 !! for packing for input v.
2128 !! @param[in] kptr Vertical pointer to the place in the edge buffer where
2129 !! data will be located.
2130 ! =========================================
2131 subroutine GhostVpackfull(edge,v,nc1,nc2,nc,vlyr,kptr,desc)
2132
2133 use dimensions_mod, only : max_corner_elem
2134 use control_mod, only : north, south, east, west, neast, nwest, seast, swest
2135 use edgetype_mod, only : ghostbuffer3d_t
2136
2137 implicit none
2138 type (Ghostbuffer3D_t) :: edge
2139 integer, intent(in) :: vlyr
2140 integer, intent(in) :: nc1,nc2,nc,kptr
2141 real (kind=real_kind),intent(in) :: v(nc1:nc2,nc1:nc2,vlyr)
2142 type (EdgeDescriptor_t),intent(in) :: desc
2143
2144 ! Local variables
2145 integer :: i,k,ir,l,e
2146
2147 integer :: is,ie,in,iw
2148
2149 if(.not. threadsafe) then
2150!$OMP BARRIER
2151 threadsafe=.true.
2152 end if
2153 ! Example convenction for buffer to the north:
2154 ! buf(:,,:,i,e)
2155 ! each "edge" is a row of data (i=1,np) in the element
2156 ! north most row of data goes into e=1
2157 ! next row of data goes into e=2
2158 ! ....
2159 ! south most row of data goes into e=np
2160 ! We need to pack this way to preserve the orientation
2161 ! so the data can be unpacked correctly
2162
2163 ! note: we think of buf as dimensioned buf(k,is,i,e)
2164 ! but this array is flatted to: buf(k,is+(i-1)+(e-1)*np)
2165 !
2166 is = desc%putmapP_ghost(south)
2167 ie = desc%putmapP_ghost(east)
2168 in = desc%putmapP_ghost(north)
2169 iw = desc%putmapP_ghost(west)
2170#if 1
2171 if (is>edge%nbuf) call abortmp('error is=')
2172 if (ie>edge%nbuf) call abortmp('error ie=')
2173 if (in>edge%nbuf) call abortmp('error in=')
2174 if (iw>edge%nbuf) call abortmp('error iw=')
2175 if (is<1) call abortmp('error is=0')
2176 if (ie<1) call abortmp('error ie=0')
2177 if (in<1) call abortmp('error in=0')
2178 if (iw<1) call abortmp('error iw=0')
2179#endif
2180
2181! print *,nc,is,ie,in,iw
2182 do k=1,vlyr
2183 do e=1,nc
2184 do i=1,nc
2185 edge%buf(i,e,kptr+k,is) = v(i ,e ,k)
2186 edge%buf(i,e,kptr+k,ie) = v(nc-e+1 ,i ,k)
2187 edge%buf(i,e,kptr+k,in) = v(i ,nc-e+1,k)
2188 edge%buf(i,e,kptr+k,iw) = v(e ,i ,k)
2189 enddo
2190 end do
2191 end do
2192
2193 ! This is really kludgy way to setup the index reversals
2194 ! But since it is so a rare event not real need to spend time optimizing
2195 ! Check if the edge orientation of the recieving element is different
2196 ! if it is, swap the order of data in the edge
2197 if(desc%reverse(south)) then
2198 is = desc%putmapP_ghost(south)
2199 do e=1,nc
2200 do k=1,vlyr
2201 do i=1,nc
2202 ir = nc-i+1
2203 edge%buf(ir,e,kptr+k,is)=v(i,e,k)
2204 enddo
2205 enddo
2206 enddo
2207 endif
2208
2209 if(desc%reverse(east)) then
2210 ie = desc%putmapP_ghost(east)
2211 do e=1,nc
2212 do k=1,vlyr
2213 do i=1,nc
2214 ir = nc-i+1
2215 edge%buf(ir,e,kptr+k,ie)=v(nc-e+1,i,k)
2216 enddo
2217 enddo
2218 enddo
2219 endif
2220
2221 if(desc%reverse(north)) then
2222 in = desc%putmapP_ghost(north)
2223 do e=1,nc
2224 do k=1,vlyr
2225 do i=1,nc
2226 ir = nc-i+1
2227 edge%buf(ir,e,kptr+k,in)=v(i,nc-e+1,k)
2228 enddo
2229 enddo
2230 enddo
2231 endif
2232
2233 if(desc%reverse(west)) then
2234 iw = desc%putmapP_ghost(west)
2235 do e=1,nc
2236 do k=1,vlyr
2237 do i=1,nc
2238 ir = nc-i+1
2239 edge%buf(ir,e,kptr+k,iw)=v(e,i,k)
2240 enddo
2241 enddo
2242 enddo
2243 endif
2244
2245
2246
2247 ! corners. this is difficult because we dont know the orientaton
2248 ! of the corners, and this which (i,j) dimension maps to which dimension
2249! SWEST
2250 do l=swest, swest+max_corner_elem-1
2251 if (desc%putmapP_ghost(l) /= -1) then
2252 do k=1,vlyr
2253 do e=1,nc
2254 edge%buf(:,e,kptr+k,desc%putmapP_ghost(l))=v(1:nc ,e ,k)
2255 enddo
2256 end do
2257 end if
2258 end do
2259
2260! SEAST
2261 do l=swest+max_corner_elem, swest+2*max_corner_elem-1
2262 if (desc%putmapP_ghost(l) /= -1) then
2263 do k=1,vlyr
2264 do e=1,nc
2265 edge%buf(e,:,kptr+k,desc%putmapP_ghost(l))=v(nc-e+1 ,1:nc ,k)
2266 enddo
2267 end do
2268 end if
2269 end do
2270
2271! NEAST
2272 do l=swest+3*max_corner_elem,swest+4*max_corner_elem-1
2273 if (desc%putmapP_ghost(l) /= -1) then
2274 do k=1,vlyr
2275 do e=1,nc
2276 do i=1,nc
2277 edge%buf(i,e,kptr+k,desc%putmapP_ghost(l))=v(nc-i+1,nc-e+1,k)
2278 enddo
2279 enddo
2280 end do
2281 end if
2282 end do
2283
2284! NWEST
2285 do l=swest+2*max_corner_elem,swest+3*max_corner_elem-1
2286 if (desc%putmapP_ghost(l) /= -1) then
2287 do k=1,vlyr
2288 do e=1,nc
2289 edge%buf(:,e,kptr+k,desc%putmapP_ghost(l))=v(1:nc ,nc-e+1,k)
2290 enddo
2291 end do
2292 end if
2293 end do
2294 end subroutine GhostVpackfull
2295
2296 ! ========================================
2297 ! edgeVunpack:
2298 !
2299 ! Unpack edges from edge buffer into v...
2300 ! ========================================
2301
2302 subroutine GhostVunpackfull(edge,v,nc1,nc2,nc,vlyr,kptr,desc)
2303 use dimensions_mod, only : max_corner_elem
2304 use control_mod, only : north, south, east, west, neast, nwest, seast, swest
2305 use edgetype_mod, only : Ghostbuffer3d_t
2306 implicit none
2307 type (Ghostbuffer3D_t), intent(in) :: edge
2308
2309 integer, intent(in) :: vlyr
2310 integer, intent(in) :: kptr,nc1,nc2,nc
2311 real (kind=real_kind), intent(inout) :: v(nc1:nc2,nc1:nc2,vlyr)
2312 type (EdgeDescriptor_t) :: desc
2313
2314 ! Local
2315 logical, parameter :: UseUnroll = .TRUE.
2316 integer :: i,k,l,e
2317 integer :: is,ie,in,iw,ic
2318 logical :: reverse
2319
2320 ! make sure buffer is big enough:
2321 if ( (nc2-nc1+1) < 3*nc ) then
2322 call haltmp("GhostVunpack: insufficient ghost cell region")
2323 endif
2324
2325
2326 threadsafe=.false.
2327
2328 is=desc%getmapP_ghost(south)
2329 ie=desc%getmapP_ghost(east)
2330 in=desc%getmapP_ghost(north)
2331 iw=desc%getmapP_ghost(west)
2332
2333 ! example for north buffer
2334 ! first row ('edge') goes in v(:,np+1,k)
2335 ! 2nd row ('edge') goes in v(:,np+2,k)
2336 ! etc...
2337 do e=1,nc
2338 do k=1,vlyr
2339 do i=1,nc
2340 v(i ,1-e ,k) = edge%buf(i,e,kptr+k,is )
2341 v(nc+e ,i ,k) = edge%buf(i,e,kptr+k,ie )
2342 v(i ,nc+e ,k) = edge%buf(i,e,kptr+k,in )
2343 v(1-e ,i ,k) = edge%buf(i,e,kptr+k,iw )
2344 end do
2345 end do
2346 end do
2347
2348! SWEST
2349 do l=swest,swest+max_corner_elem-1
2350 ic = desc%getmapP_ghost(l)
2351 if (ic /= -1 .and. l.eq.swest) then ! unpack swest corner, IGNORE all other corners
2352 !if(ic /= -1) then
2353 reverse=desc%reverse(l)
2354 if (reverse) then
2355 do k=1,vlyr
2356 !v(0 ,0 ,k)=edge%buf(1,1,kptr+k,desc%getmapP_ghost(l))
2357 do e=1,nc
2358 do i=1,nc
2359 v(1-e,1-i,k)=edge%buf(i,e,kptr+k,ic)
2360 enddo
2361 enddo
2362 enddo
2363 else
2364 do k=1,vlyr
2365 !v(0 ,0 ,k)=edge%buf(1,1,kptr+k,desc%getmapP_ghost(l))
2366 do e=1,nc
2367 do i=1,nc
2368 v(1-e,1-i,k)=edge%buf(e,i,kptr+k,ic)
2369 enddo
2370 enddo
2371 enddo
2372 endif
2373 endif
2374 end do
2375
2376! SEAST
2377 do l=swest+max_corner_elem,swest+2*max_corner_elem-1
2378 ic = desc%getmapP_ghost(l)
2379 if (ic /= -1 .and. l.eq.seast) then ! unpack seast corner, IGNORE all other corners
2380 !if(ic /= -1) then
2381 reverse=desc%reverse(l)
2382 if (reverse) then
2383 do k=1,vlyr
2384 !v(nc+1 ,0 ,k)=edge%buf(1,1,kptr+k,desc%getmapP_ghost(l))
2385 do e=1,nc
2386 do i=1,nc
2387 v(nc+i,1-e,k)=edge%buf(e,i,kptr+k,ic)
2388 enddo
2389 enddo
2390 enddo
2391 else
2392 do k=1,vlyr
2393 !v(nc+1 ,0 ,k)=edge%buf(1,1,kptr+k,desc%getmapP_ghost(l))
2394 do e=1,nc
2395 do i=1,nc
2396 v(nc+i ,1-e ,k)=edge%buf(i,e,kptr+k,ic)
2397 enddo
2398 enddo
2399 enddo
2400 endif
2401 endif
2402 end do
2403
2404! NEAST
2405 do l=swest+3*max_corner_elem,swest+4*max_corner_elem-1
2406 ic = desc%getmapP_ghost(l)
2407 if (ic /= -1 .and. l.eq.neast) then ! unpack neast corner, IGNORE all other corners
2408 !if(ic /= -1) then
2409 reverse=desc%reverse(l)
2410 if (reverse) then
2411 do k=1,vlyr
2412 !v(nc+1 ,nc+1,k)=edge%buf(1,1,kptr+k,desc%getmapP_ghost(l))
2413 do e=1,nc
2414 do i=1,nc
2415 v(nc+i ,nc+e,k)=edge%buf(e,i,kptr+k,ic)
2416 enddo
2417 enddo
2418 enddo
2419 else
2420 do k=1,vlyr
2421 !v(nc+1 ,nc+1,k)=edge%buf(1,1,kptr+k,desc%getmapP_ghost(l))
2422 do e=1,nc
2423 do i=1,nc
2424 v(nc+i ,nc+e,k)=edge%buf(i,e,kptr+k,ic)
2425 enddo
2426 enddo
2427 enddo
2428 endif
2429 endif
2430 end do
2431
2432! NWEST
2433 do l=swest+2*max_corner_elem,swest+3*max_corner_elem-1
2434 ic = desc%getmapP_ghost(l)
2435 if (ic /= -1 .and. l.eq.nwest) then
2436 ! unpack nwest corner, IGNORE all other corners
2437 reverse=desc%reverse(l)
2438 if (reverse) then
2439 do k=1,vlyr
2440 !v(0 ,nc+1,k)=edge%buf(1,1,kptr+k,desc%getmapP_ghost(l))
2441 do e=1,nc
2442 do i=1,nc
2443 v(1-i ,nc+e,k)=edge%buf(e,i,kptr+k,ic)
2444 enddo
2445 enddo
2446 enddo
2447 else
2448 do k=1,vlyr
2449 !v(0 ,nc+1,k)=edge%buf(1,1,kptr+k,desc%getmapP_ghost(l))
2450 do e=1,nc
2451 do i=1,nc
2452 v(1-i ,nc+e,k)=edge%buf(i,e,kptr+k,ic)
2453 enddo
2454 enddo
2455 enddo
2456 endif
2457 endif
2458 end do
2459
2460 end subroutine GhostVunpackfull

2467 ! =========================================
2468 !
2469 !> @brief Pack edges of v into an edge buffer for boundary exchange.
2470 !
2471 !> This subroutine packs for one or more vertical layers into an edge
2472 !! buffer. If the buffer associated with edge is not large enough to
2473 !! hold all vertical layers you intent to pack, the method will
2474 !! halt the program with a call to parallel_mod::haltmp().
2475 !! @param[in] edge Ghost Buffer into which the data will be packed.
2476 !! This buffer must be previously allocated with initghostbuffer().
2477 !! @param[in] v The data to be packed.
2478 !! @param[in] vlyr Number of vertical level coming into the subroutine
2479 !! for packing for input v.
2480 !! @param[in] kptr Vertical pointer to the place in the edge buffer where
2481 !! data will be located.
2482 ! =========================================
2483 subroutine GhostVpack_unoriented(edge,v,nc,vlyr,kptr,desc)
2484 use edgetype_mod, only : edgedescriptor_t, ghostbuffer3d_t
2485 implicit none
2486 type (Ghostbuffer3D_t),intent(inout) :: edge
2487 integer, intent(in) :: vlyr
2488 integer, intent(in) :: nc
2489 real (kind=real_kind),intent(in) :: v(nc,nc,vlyr)
2490 integer, intent(in) :: kptr
2491 type (EdgeDescriptor_t),intent(in) :: desc
2492
2493 integer :: k,l,l_local,is
2494
2495 if(.not. threadsafe) then
2496!$OMP BARRIER
2497 threadsafe=.true.
2498 end if
2499
2500 do l_local=1,desc%actual_neigh_edges
2501 l=desc%loc2buf(l_local)
2502 is = desc%putmapP_ghost(l)
2503 do k=1,vlyr
2504 edge%buf(:,:,kptr+k,is) = v(:,:,k)
2505 enddo
2506 end do
2507
2508 end subroutine GhostVpack_unoriented
2509
2510
2511 ! ========================================
2512 ! edgeVunpack:
2513 !
2514 ! Unpack edges from edge buffer into v...
2515 ! ========================================
2516 subroutine GhostVunpack_unoriented(edge,v,nc,vlyr,kptr,desc,GlobalId,u)
2517
2518 use edgetype_mod, only : Ghostbuffer3d_t, EdgeDescriptor_t
2519 implicit none
2520
2521 type (Ghostbuffer3D_t),intent(inout) :: edge
2522 integer, intent(in) :: vlyr
2523 integer, intent(in) :: nc
2524 real (kind=real_kind), intent(out) :: v(nc,nc,vlyr,*)
2525 integer, intent(in) :: kptr
2526 type (EdgeDescriptor_t),intent(in) :: desc
2527 integer(kind=int_kind),intent(in) :: GlobalId
2528 real (kind=real_kind), intent(in) :: u(nc,nc,vlyr)
2529
2530 integer :: k,l,n,is,m,pid,gid
2531
2532 threadsafe=.false.
2533
2534 m=0
2535 gid = GlobalID
2536 do n=1,desc%actual_neigh_edges+1
2537 pid = desc%globalID(desc%loc2buf((m+1)))
2538 if (m==desc%actual_neigh_edges .OR. pid < gid) then
2539 gid = -1
2540 v(:,:,:,n) = u(:,:,:)
2541 else
2542 m = m+1
2543 l = desc%loc2buf(m)
2544 is = desc%getmapP_ghost(l)
2545 do k=1,vlyr
2546 v(:,:,k,n) = edge%buf(:,:,kptr+k,is)
2547 enddo
2548 end if
2549 end do
2550
2551
2552 end subroutine GhostVunpack_unoriented

2564 ! =========================================
2565 ! initGhostBuffer:
2566 ! Author: Christoph Erath
2567 ! create an Real based communication buffer
2568 ! npoints is the number of points on one side
2569 ! nhc is the deep of the ghost/halo zone
2570 ! =========================================
2571 subroutine initGhostBufferTR(ghost,nlyr,ntrac,nhc, npoints)
2572
2573 implicit none
2574 integer,intent(in) :: nlyr,ntrac,nhc, npoints
2575 type (Ghostbuffertr_t),intent(out) :: ghost
2576
2577 ! Local variables
2578
2579 integer :: nbuf
2580
2581 ! make sure buffer is big enough:
2582 if (nhc>npoints ) then
2583 call haltmp("intGhostBuffer: halo region can not be larger then element size")
2584 endif
2585 if (ntrac<1 ) then
2586 call haltmp("intGhostBuffer: you have to consider at least one tracer")
2587 endif
2588
2589 ! sanity check for threading
2590 if (omp_get_num_threads()>1) then
2591 call haltmp('ERROR: initGhostBuffer must be called before threaded region')
2592 endif
2593
2594 nbuf=max_neigh_edges*nelemd
2595!$OMP MASTER
2596 ghost%nlyr=nlyr
2597 ghost%nbuf=nbuf
2598 allocate(ghost%buf(npoints,nhc,nlyr,ntrac,nbuf))
2599 ghost%buf=0
2600
2601 allocate(ghost%receive(npoints,nhc,nlyr,ntrac,nbuf))
2602 ghost%receive=0
2603!$OMP END MASTER
2604!$OMP BARRIER
2605
2606 end subroutine initGhostBufferTR
2607

2610! =========================================
2611! Christoph Erath
2612!> Packs the halo zone from v
2613! =========================================
2614
2615subroutine ghostVpack(edge,v,nhc,npoints,vlyr,ntrac,kptr,desc)
2616
2617 use dimensions_mod, only : max_corner_elem
2618 use control_mod, only : north, south, east, west, neast, nwest, seast, swest
2619 use edgetype_mod, only : EdgeDescriptor_t, Ghostbuffertr_t
2620
2621 implicit none
2622
2623 type (Ghostbuffertr_t) :: edge
2624 integer, intent(in) :: vlyr
2625 integer, intent(in) :: ntrac
2626 integer, intent(in) :: npoints,nhc, kptr
2627
2628 real (kind=real_kind),intent(in) :: v(1-nhc:npoints+nhc,1-nhc:npoints+nhc,vlyr,ntrac)
2629 type (EdgeDescriptor_t),intent(in) :: desc
2630
2631 ! Local variables
2632 integer :: i,j,k,ir,l,itr
2633
2634 integer :: is,ie,in,iw
2635
2636 if(.not. threadsafe) then
2637!$OMP BARRIER
2638 threadsafe=.true.
2639 end if
2640 ! Example convenction for buffer to the north:
2641 ! buf(:,,:,i,e)
2642 ! each "edge" is a row of data (i=1,np) in the element
2643 ! north most row of data goes into e=1
2644 ! next row of data goes into e=2
2645 ! ....
2646 ! south most row of data goes into e=np
2647 ! We need to pack this way to preserve the orientation
2648 ! so the data can be unpacked correctly
2649
2650 ! note: we think of buf as dimensioned buf(k,is,i,e)
2651 ! but this array is flatted to: buf(k,is+(i-1)+(e-1)*np)
2652 !
2653 is = desc%putmapP_ghost(south)
2654 ie = desc%putmapP_ghost(east)
2655 in = desc%putmapP_ghost(north)
2656 iw = desc%putmapP_ghost(west)
2657
2658! print *,nc,is,ie,in,iw
2659 do itr=1,ntrac
2660 do k=1,vlyr
2661 do i=1,npoints
2662 do j=1,nhc
2663 edge%buf(i,j,k,itr+kptr,is) = v(i ,j ,k,itr)
2664 edge%buf(i,j,k,itr+kptr,ie) = v(npoints-j+1 ,i ,k,itr)
2665 edge%buf(i,j,k,itr+kptr,in) = v(i ,npoints-j+1,k,itr)
2666 edge%buf(i,j,k,itr+kptr,iw) = v(j ,i ,k,itr)
2667 enddo
2668 end do
2669 end do
2670 end do
2671
2672 ! This is really kludgy way to setup the index reversals
2673 ! But since it is so a rare event not real need to spend time optimizing
2674 ! Check if the edge orientation of the recieving element is different
2675 ! if it is, swap the order of data in the edge
2676 if(desc%reverse(south)) then
2677! is = desc%putmapP_ghost(south)
2678 do itr=1,ntrac
2679 do k=1,vlyr
2680 do i=1,npoints
2681 do j=1,nhc
2682 ir = npoints-i+1
2683 edge%buf(ir,j,k,itr+kptr,is)=v(i,j,k,itr)
2684 enddo
2685 enddo
2686 enddo
2687 enddo
2688 endif
2689
2690 if(desc%reverse(east)) then
2691! ie = desc%putmapP_ghost(east)
2692 do itr=1,ntrac
2693 do k=1,vlyr
2694 do i=1,npoints
2695 do j=1,nhc
2696 ir = npoints-i+1
2697 edge%buf(ir,j,k,itr+kptr,ie)=v(npoints-j+1,i,k,itr)
2698 enddo
2699 enddo
2700 enddo
2701 end do
2702 endif
2703
2704 if(desc%reverse(north)) then
2705! in = desc%putmapP_ghost(north)
2706 do itr=1,ntrac
2707 do k=1,vlyr
2708 do i=1,npoints
2709 do j=1,nhc
2710 ir = npoints-i+1
2711 edge%buf(ir,j,k,itr+kptr,in)=v(i,npoints-j+1,k,itr)
2712 enddo
2713 enddo
2714 enddo
2715 enddo
2716 endif
2717
2718 if(desc%reverse(west)) then
2719! iw = desc%putmapP_ghost(west)
2720 do itr=1,ntrac
2721 do k=1,vlyr
2722 do i=1,npoints
2723 do j=1,nhc
2724 ir = npoints-i+1
2725 edge%buf(ir,j,k,itr+kptr,iw)=v(j,i,k,itr)
2726 enddo
2727 enddo
2728 enddo
2729 enddo
2730 endif
2731
2732
2733
2734 ! corners. this is difficult because we dont know the orientaton
2735 ! of the corners, and this which (i,j) dimension maps to which dimension
2736! SWEST
2737 do l=swest,swest+max_corner_elem-1
2738 if (l.ne.swest) call abortmp('ERROR2: swest ghost cell update requires ne>0 cubed-sphere mesh')
2739 if (desc%putmapP_ghost(l) /= -1) then
2740 do itr=1,ntrac
2741 do k=1,vlyr
2742 ! edge%buf(1,1,kptr+k,desc%putmapP_ghost(l))=v(1,1 ,k)
2743 do i=1,nhc
2744 do j=1,nhc
2745 edge%buf(i,j,k,itr+kptr,desc%putmapP_ghost(l))=v(i ,j ,k,itr)
2746 enddo
2747 end do
2748 end do
2749 enddo
2750 end if
2751 end do
2752
2753! SEAST
2754 do l=swest+max_corner_elem,swest+2*max_corner_elem-1
2755 if (l.ne.seast) call abortmp('ERROR2: seast ghost cell update requires ne>0 cubed-sphere mesh')
2756 if (desc%putmapP_ghost(l) /= -1) then
2757 do itr=1,ntrac
2758 do k=1,vlyr
2759 ! edge%buf(1,1,kptr+k,desc%putmapP_ghost(l))=v(nc ,1 ,k)
2760 do i=1,nhc
2761 do j=1,nhc
2762 edge%buf(i,j,k,itr+kptr,desc%putmapP_ghost(l))=v(npoints-i+1 ,j ,k,itr)
2763 enddo
2764 end do
2765 end do
2766 enddo
2767 end if
2768 end do
2769
2770! NEAST
2771 do l=swest+3*max_corner_elem,swest+4*max_corner_elem-1
2772 if (l.ne.neast) call abortmp('ERROR2: neast ghost cell update requires ne>0 cubed-sphere mesh')
2773 if (desc%putmapP_ghost(l) /= -1) then
2774 do itr=1,ntrac
2775 do k=1,vlyr
2776 !edge%buf(1,1,kptr+k,desc%putmapP_ghost(l))=v(nc ,nc,k)
2777 do i=1,nhc
2778 do j=1,nhc
2779 edge%buf(i,j,k,itr+kptr,desc%putmapP_ghost(l))=v(npoints-i+1,npoints-j+1,k,itr)
2780 enddo
2781 enddo
2782 end do
2783 enddo
2784 end if
2785 end do
2786
2787! NWEST
2788 do l=swest+2*max_corner_elem,swest+3*max_corner_elem-1
2789 if (l.ne.nwest) call abortmp('ERROR2: nwest ghost cell update requires ne>0 cubed-sphere mesh')
2790 if (desc%putmapP_ghost(l) /= -1) then
2791 do itr=1,ntrac
2792 do k=1,vlyr
2793 !edge%buf(1,1,kptr+k,desc%putmapP_ghost(l))=v(1 ,nc,k)
2794 do i=1,nhc
2795 do j=1,nhc
2796 edge%buf(i,j,k,itr+kptr,desc%putmapP_ghost(l))=v(i ,npoints-j+1,k,itr)
2797 enddo
2798 end do
2799 end do
2800 enddo
2801 end if
2802 end do
2803end subroutine GhostVpack
2804

2806! =========================================
2807! Christoph Erath
2808!> Packs the halo zone from v
2809! =========================================
2810! NOTE: I have to give timelevels as argument, because element_mod is not compiled first
2811! and the array call has to be done in this way because of performance reasons!!!
2812subroutine ghostVpackR(edge,v,nhc,npoints,vlyr,ntrac,kptr,desc)
2813 use dimensions_mod, only : max_corner_elem!, ntrac_d
2814 use control_mod, only : north, south, east, west, neast, nwest, seast, swest
2815 use edgetype_mod, only : Ghostbuffertr_t
2816 implicit none
2817 type (Ghostbuffertr_t) :: edge
2818 integer, intent(in) :: vlyr
2819 integer, intent(in) :: ntrac
2820 integer, intent(in) :: npoints,nhc,kptr
2821
2822! real (kind=real_kind),intent(in) :: v(1-nhc:npoints+nhc,1-nhc:npoints+nhc,vlyr,ntrac_d)
2823 real (kind=real_kind),intent(in) :: v(1-nhc:npoints+nhc,1-nhc:npoints+nhc,vlyr,ntrac)!phl
2824 type (EdgeDescriptor_t),intent(in) :: desc
2825
2826 ! Local variables
2827 integer :: i,j,k,ir,l,itr
2828
2829 integer :: is,ie,in,iw
2830
2831 if(.not. threadsafe) then
2832!$OMP BARRIER
2833 threadsafe=.true.
2834 end if
2835 ! Example convenction for buffer to the north:
2836 ! buf(:,,:,i,e)
2837 ! each "edge" is a row of data (i=1,np) in the element
2838 ! north most row of data goes into e=1
2839 ! next row of data goes into e=2
2840 ! ....
2841 ! south most row of data goes into e=np
2842 ! We need to pack this way to preserve the orientation
2843 ! so the data can be unpacked correctly
2844
2845 ! note: we think of buf as dimensioned buf(k,is,i,e)
2846 ! but this array is flatted to: buf(k,is+(i-1)+(e-1)*np)
2847 !
2848 is = desc%putmapP_ghost(south)
2849 ie = desc%putmapP_ghost(east)
2850 in = desc%putmapP_ghost(north)
2851 iw = desc%putmapP_ghost(west)
2852
2853! print *,nc,is,ie,in,iw
2854 do itr=1,ntrac
2855 do k=1,vlyr
2856 do i=1,npoints
2857 do j=1,nhc
2858 edge%buf(i,j,kptr+k,itr,is) = v(i ,j ,k,itr)
2859 edge%buf(i,j,kptr+k,itr,ie) = v(npoints-j+1 ,i ,k,itr)
2860 edge%buf(i,j,kptr+k,itr,in) = v(i ,npoints-j+1,k,itr)
2861 edge%buf(i,j,kptr+k,itr,iw) = v(j ,i ,k,itr)
2862 enddo
2863 end do
2864 end do
2865 end do
2866
2867 ! This is really kludgy way to setup the index reversals
2868 ! But since it is so a rare event not real need to spend time optimizing
2869 ! Check if the edge orientation of the recieving element is different
2870 ! if it is, swap the order of data in the edge
2871 if(desc%reverse(south)) then
2872! is = desc%putmapP_ghost(south)
2873 do itr=1,ntrac
2874 do k=1,vlyr
2875 do i=1,npoints
2876 do j=1,nhc
2877 ir = npoints-i+1
2878 edge%buf(ir,j,kptr+k,itr,is)=v(i,j,k,itr)
2879 enddo
2880 enddo
2881 enddo
2882 enddo
2883 endif
2884
2885 if(desc%reverse(east)) then
2886! ie = desc%putmapP_ghost(east)
2887 do itr=1,ntrac
2888 do k=1,vlyr
2889 do i=1,npoints
2890 do j=1,nhc
2891 ir = npoints-i+1
2892 edge%buf(ir,j,kptr+k,itr,ie)=v(npoints-j+1,i,k,itr)
2893 enddo
2894 enddo
2895 enddo
2896 end do
2897 endif
2898
2899 if(desc%reverse(north)) then
2900! in = desc%putmapP_ghost(north)
2901 do itr=1,ntrac
2902 do k=1,vlyr
2903 do i=1,npoints
2904 do j=1,nhc
2905 ir = npoints-i+1
2906 edge%buf(ir,j,kptr+k,itr,in)=v(i,npoints-j+1,k,itr)
2907 enddo
2908 enddo
2909 enddo
2910 enddo
2911 endif
2912
2913 if(desc%reverse(west)) then
2914! iw = desc%putmapP_ghost(west)
2915 do itr=1,ntrac
2916 do k=1,vlyr
2917 do i=1,npoints
2918 do j=1,nhc
2919 ir = npoints-i+1
2920 edge%buf(ir,j,kptr+k,itr,iw)=v(j,i,k,itr)
2921 enddo
2922 enddo
2923 enddo
2924 enddo
2925 endif
2926
2927
2928
2929 ! corners. this is difficult because we dont know the orientaton
2930 ! of the corners, and this which (i,j) dimension maps to which dimension
2931! SWEST
2932 do l=swest,swest+max_corner_elem-1
2933 if (l.ne.swest) call abortmp('ERROR2: swest ghost cell update requires ne>0 cubed-sphere mesh')
2934 if (desc%putmapP_ghost(l) /= -1) then
2935 do itr=1,ntrac
2936 do k=1,vlyr
2937 ! edge%buf(1,1,kptr+k,desc%putmapP_ghost(l))=v(1,1 ,k)
2938 do i=1,nhc
2939 do j=1,nhc
2940 edge%buf(i,j,kptr+k,itr,desc%putmapP_ghost(l))=v(i ,j ,k,itr)
2941 enddo
2942 end do
2943 end do
2944 enddo
2945 end if
2946 end do
2947
2948! SEAST
2949 do l=swest+max_corner_elem,swest+2*max_corner_elem-1
2950 if (l.ne.seast) call abortmp('ERROR2: seast ghost cell update requires ne>0 cubed-sphere mesh')
2951 if (desc%putmapP_ghost(l) /= -1) then
2952 do itr=1,ntrac
2953 do k=1,vlyr
2954 ! edge%buf(1,1,kptr+k,desc%putmapP_ghost(l))=v(nc ,1 ,k)
2955 do i=1,nhc
2956 do j=1,nhc
2957 edge%buf(i,j,kptr+k,itr,desc%putmapP_ghost(l))=v(npoints-i+1 ,j ,k,itr)
2958 enddo
2959 end do
2960 end do
2961 enddo
2962 end if
2963 end do
2964
2965! NEAST
2966 do l=swest+3*max_corner_elem,swest+4*max_corner_elem-1
2967 if (l.ne.neast) call abortmp('ERROR2: neast ghost cell update requires ne>0 cubed-sphere mesh')
2968 if (desc%putmapP_ghost(l) /= -1) then
2969 do itr=1,ntrac
2970 do k=1,vlyr
2971 !edge%buf(1,1,kptr+k,desc%putmapP_ghost(l))=v(nc ,nc,k)
2972 do i=1,nhc
2973 do j=1,nhc
2974 edge%buf(i,j,kptr+k,itr,desc%putmapP_ghost(l))=v(npoints-i+1,npoints-j+1,k,itr)
2975 enddo
2976 enddo
2977 end do
2978 enddo
2979 end if
2980 end do
2981
2982! NWEST
2983 do l=swest+2*max_corner_elem,swest+3*max_corner_elem-1
2984 if (l.ne.nwest) call abortmp('ERROR2: nwest ghost cell update requires ne>0 cubed-sphere mesh')
2985 if (desc%putmapP_ghost(l) /= -1) then
2986 do itr=1,ntrac
2987 do k=1,vlyr
2988 !edge%buf(1,1,kptr+k,desc%putmapP_ghost(l))=v(1 ,nc,k)
2989 do i=1,nhc
2990 do j=1,nhc
2991 edge%buf(i,j,kptr+k,itr,desc%putmapP_ghost(l))=v(i ,npoints-j+1,k,itr)
2992 enddo
2993 end do
2994 end do
2995 enddo
2996 end if
2997 end do
2998end subroutine GhostVpackR

3433 ! =================================================================================
3434 ! GHOSTVPACK2D
3435 ! AUTHOR: Christoph Erath
3436 ! Pack edges of v into an ghost buffer for boundary exchange.
3437 !
3438 ! This subroutine packs for one vertical layers into an ghost
3439 ! buffer. It is for cartesian points (v is only two dimensional).
3440 ! If the buffer associated with edge is not large enough to
3441 ! hold all vertical layers you intent to pack, the method will
3442 ! halt the program with a call to parallel_mod::haltmp().
3443 ! INPUT:
3444 ! - ghost Buffer into which the data will be packed.
3445 ! This buffer must be previously allocated with initGhostBuffer().
3446 ! - v The data to be packed.
3447 ! - nhc deep of ghost/halo zone
3448 ! - npoints number of points on on side
3449 ! - kptr Vertical pointer to the place in the edge buffer where
3450 ! data will be located.
3451 ! =================================================================================
3452 subroutine ghostVpack2d(ghost,v,nhc, npoints,vlyr,ntrac,kptr,tn0,timelevels,desc)
3453 use dimensions_mod, only : max_corner_elem!, ntrac_d
3454 use control_mod, only : north, south, east, west, neast, nwest, seast, swest
3455
3456 type (Ghostbuffertr_t) :: ghost
3457 integer, intent(in) :: vlyr
3458 integer, intent(in) :: ntrac
3459 integer, intent(in) :: nhc,npoints,kptr, tn0, timelevels
3460
3461 real (kind=real_kind),intent(in) :: v(1-nhc:npoints+nhc,1-nhc:npoints+nhc, vlyr, ntrac,timelevels)!phl
3462! real (kind=real_kind),intent(in) :: v(1-nhc:npoints+nhc,1-nhc:npoints+nhc, vlyr, ntrac_d,timelevels)
3463 type (EdgeDescriptor_t),intent(in) :: desc
3464
3465 ! Local variables
3466 integer :: i,j,ir,l,e
3467 integer :: itr,k
3468 integer :: is,ie,in,iw
3469
3470
3471 if(.not. threadsafe) then
3472 !$OMP BARRIER
3473 threadsafe=.true.
3474 end if
3475 ! Example convenction for buffer to the north:
3476 ! buf(:,,:,i,e)
3477 ! each "edge" is a row of data (i=1,np) in the element
3478 ! north most row of data goes into e=1
3479 ! next row of data goes into e=2
3480 ! ....
3481 ! south most row of data goes into e=np
3482 ! We need to pack this way to preserve the orientation
3483 ! so the data can be unpacked correctly
3484
3485 ! note: we think of buf as dimensioned buf(k,is,i,e)
3486 ! but this array is flatted to: buf(k,is+(i-1)+(e-1)*np)
3487 !
3488 is = desc%putmapP_ghost(south)
3489 ie = desc%putmapP_ghost(east)
3490 in = desc%putmapP_ghost(north)
3491 iw = desc%putmapP_ghost(west)
3492 do itr=1,ntrac
3493 do k=1,vlyr
3494 do i=1,npoints
3495 do j=1,nhc
3496 ghost%buf(i,j,kptr+k,itr,is) = v(i ,j+1, k,itr,tn0)
3497 ghost%buf(i,j,kptr+k,itr,ie) = v(npoints-j,i, k,itr,tn0 )
3498 ghost%buf(i,j,kptr+k,itr,in) = v(i ,npoints-j, k,itr,tn0)
3499 ghost%buf(i,j,kptr+k,itr,iw) = v(j+1,i, k,itr,tn0 )
3500 enddo
3501 end do
3502 end do
3503 end do
3504
3505 ! This is really kludgy way to setup the index reversals
3506 ! But since it is so a rare event not real need to spend time optimizing
3507 ! Check if the edge orientation of the recieving element is different
3508 ! if it is, swap the order of data in the edge
3509 if(desc%reverse(south)) then
3510 ! is = desc%putmapP_ghost(south)
3511 do itr=1,ntrac
3512 do k=1,vlyr
3513 do i=1,npoints
3514 do j=1,nhc
3515 ir = npoints-i+1
3516 ghost%buf(ir,j,kptr+k,itr,is)=v(i,j+1, k,itr,tn0)
3517 enddo
3518 enddo
3519 end do
3520 end do
3521 endif
3522
3523 if(desc%reverse(east)) then
3524 ! ie = desc%putmapP_ghost(east)
3525 do itr=1,ntrac
3526 do k=1,vlyr
3527 do i=1,npoints
3528 do j=1,nhc
3529 ir = npoints-i+1
3530 ghost%buf(ir,j,kptr+k,itr,ie)=v(npoints-j,i, k,itr,tn0)
3531 enddo
3532 enddo
3533 end do
3534 end do
3535 endif
3536
3537 if(desc%reverse(north)) then
3538 ! in = desc%putmapP_ghost(north)
3539 do itr=1,ntrac
3540 do k=1,vlyr
3541 do i=1,npoints
3542 do j=1,nhc
3543 ir = npoints-i+1

3546 enddo
3547 end do
3548 end do
3549 endif
3550
3551 if(desc%reverse(west)) then
3552 ! iw = desc%putmapP_ghost(west)
3553 do itr=1,ntrac
3554 do k=1,vlyr

3556 do j=1,nhc
3557 ir = npoints-i+1

3560 enddo
3561 enddo
3562 enddo
3563 endif
3564
3565 ! corners. this is difficult because we dont know the orientaton
3566 ! of the corners, and this which (i,j) dimension maps to which dimension
3567 ! SWEST
3568 do l=swest,swest+max_corner_elem-1
3569 if (l.ne.swest) call abortmp('ERROR3: swest ghost cell update requires ne>0 cubed-sphere mesh')
3570 if (desc%putmapP_ghost(l) /= -1) then
3571 do itr=1,ntrac
3572 do k=1,vlyr
3573 do i=1,nhc
3574 do j=1,nhc
3575 ghost%buf(i,j,kptr+k,itr,desc%putmapP_ghost(l))=v(i+1,j+1,k,itr,tn0 )
3576 enddo
3577 enddo
3578 enddo
3579 enddo
3580 end if
3581 end do
3582
3583 ! SEAST
3584 do l=swest+max_corner_elem,swest+2*max_corner_elem-1
3585 if (l.ne.seast) call abortmp('ERROR3: seast ghost cell update requires ne>0 cubed-sphere mesh')
3586 if (desc%putmapP_ghost(l) /= -1) then
3587 do itr=1,ntrac
3588 do k=1,vlyr
3589 do i=1,nhc
3590 do j=1,nhc
3591 ghost%buf(i,j,kptr+k,itr,desc%putmapP_ghost(l))=v(npoints-i ,j+1,k,itr,tn0)
3592 enddo
3593 enddo
3594 enddo
3595 enddo
3596 end if
3597 end do
3598
3599 ! NEAST
3600 do l=swest+3*max_corner_elem,swest+4*max_corner_elem-1
3601 if (l.ne.neast) call abortmp('ERROR3: neast ghost cell update requires ne>0 cubed-sphere mesh')
3602 if (desc%putmapP_ghost(l) /= -1) then
3603 do itr=1,ntrac
3604 do k=1,vlyr
3605 do i=1,nhc
3606 do j=1,nhc
3607 ghost%buf(i,j,kptr+k,itr,desc%putmapP_ghost(l))=v(npoints-i,npoints-j,k,itr,tn0)
3608 enddo
3609 enddo
3610 enddo
3611 enddo
3612 end if
3613 end do
3614
3615 ! NWEST
3616 do l=swest+2*max_corner_elem,swest+3*max_corner_elem-1
3617 if (l.ne.nwest) call abortmp('ERROR3: nwest ghost cell update requires ne>0 cubed-sphere mesh')
3618 if (desc%putmapP_ghost(l) /= -1) then
3619 do itr=1,ntrac
3620 do k=1,vlyr
3621 do i=1,nhc
3622 do j=1,nhc
3623 ghost%buf(i,j,kptr+k,itr,desc%putmapP_ghost(l))=v(i+1,npoints-j,k,itr,tn0)
3624 enddo
3625 enddo
3626 enddo
3627 enddo
3628 end if
3629 end do
3630 end subroutine ghostVpack2d

3703 enddo
3704 enddo
3705 enddo
3706 enddo
3707 endif
3708 else
3709 do itr=1,ntrac
3710 do k=1,vlyr
3711 do j=1,nhc
3712 do i=1,nhc
3713 v(1-i,1-j,k,itr,tn0)=edgeDefaultVal
3714 enddo
3715 enddo
3716 enddo
3717 enddo
3718 endif
3719 end do

3723 ic = desc%getmapP_ghost(l)
3724 if(ic /= -1) then

3728 do k=1,vlyr
3729 do j=1,nhc
3730 do i=1,nhc

3733 enddo
3734 enddo
3735 enddo

3738 do k=1,vlyr

3743 enddo
3744 enddo
3745 enddo

3753 enddo
3754 enddo
3755 enddo
3756 enddo
3757 endif

3760

3763 ic = desc%getmapP_ghost(l)
3764
3765 if(ic /= -1) then
3766 reverse=desc%reverse(l)
3767 if (reverse) then

3769 do k=1,vlyr
3770 do j=1,nhc
3771 do i=1,nhc
3772 v(npoints+i ,npoints+j,k,itr,tn0)=ghost%buf(j,i,kptr+k,itr,ic)
3773 enddo
3774 enddo
3775 enddo
3776 enddo
3777 else
3778 do itr=1,ntrac
3779 do k=1,vlyr

3781 do i=1,nhc
3782 v(npoints+i ,npoints+j,k,itr,tn0)=ghost%buf(i,j,kptr+k,itr,ic)

3784 enddo

3786 enddo

3845 ! =================================================================================
3846 ! GHOSTVPACK2D
3847 ! AUTHOR: Christoph Erath
3848 ! Pack edges of v into an ghost buffer for boundary exchange.
3849 !
3850 ! This subroutine packs for one vertical layers into an ghost
3851 ! buffer. It is for cartesian points (v is only two dimensional).
3852 ! If the buffer associated with edge is not large enough to
3853 ! hold all vertical layers you intent to pack, the method will
3854 ! halt the program with a call to parallel_mod::haltmp().
3855 ! INPUT:
3856 ! - ghost Buffer into which the data will be packed.
3857 ! This buffer must be previously allocated with initGhostBuffer().
3858 ! - v The data to be packed.
3859 ! - nhc deep of ghost/halo zone
3860 ! - npoints number of points on on side
3861 ! - kptr Vertical pointer to the place in the edge buffer where
3862 ! data will be located.
3863 ! =================================================================================
3864 subroutine ghostVpack2d_level(ghost,v,kptr,nhc, npoints,vlyr,desc)
3865 use dimensions_mod, only : max_corner_elem!, ntrac_d
3866 use control_mod, only : north, south, east, west, neast, nwest, seast, swest
3867
3868 type (Ghostbuffertr_t) :: ghost
3869 integer, intent(in) :: vlyr,kptr
3870 integer, intent(in) :: nhc,npoints
3871
3872 real (kind=real_kind),intent(in) :: v(1-nhc:,1-nhc:,:)
3873 type (EdgeDescriptor_t),intent(in) :: desc
3874
3875 ! Local variables
3876 integer :: i,j,ir,l,e
3877 integer :: itr,k
3878 integer :: is,ie,in,iw
3879
3880
3881 if(.not. threadsafe) then
3882 !$OMP BARRIER
3883 threadsafe=.true.
3884 end if
3885 ! Example convenction for buffer to the north:
3886 ! buf(:,,:,i,e)
3887 ! each "edge" is a row of data (i=1,np) in the element
3888 ! north most row of data goes into e=1
3889 ! next row of data goes into e=2
3890 ! ....
3891 ! south most row of data goes into e=np
3892 ! We need to pack this way to preserve the orientation
3893 ! so the data can be unpacked correctly
3894
3895 ! note: we think of buf as dimensioned buf(k,is,i,e)
3896 ! but this array is flatted to: buf(k,is+(i-1)+(e-1)*np)
3897 !
3898 is = desc%putmapP_ghost(south)
3899 ie = desc%putmapP_ghost(east)
3900 in = desc%putmapP_ghost(north)
3901 iw = desc%putmapP_ghost(west)
3902 do k=1,vlyr
3903 do i=1,npoints
3904 do j=1,nhc
3905 ghost%buf(i,j,k,kptr,is) = v(i ,j+1, k)
3906 ghost%buf(i,j,k,kptr,ie) = v(npoints-j,i, k)
3907 ghost%buf(i,j,k,kptr,in) = v(i ,npoints-j, k)
3908 ghost%buf(i,j,k,kptr,iw) = v(j+1,i, k)
3909 enddo
3910 end do
3911 end do
3912
3913 ! This is really kludgy way to setup the index reversals
3914 ! But since it is so a rare event not real need to spend time optimizing
3915 ! Check if the edge orientation of the recieving element is different
3916 ! if it is, swap the order of data in the edge
3917 if(desc%reverse(south)) then
3918 ! is = desc%putmapP_ghost(south)
3919 do k=1,vlyr
3920 do i=1,npoints
3921 do j=1,nhc
3922 ir = npoints-i+1
3923 ghost%buf(ir,j,k,kptr,is)=v(i,j+1, k)
3924 enddo
3925 enddo
3926 end do
3927 endif
3928
3929 if(desc%reverse(east)) then
3930 ! ie = desc%putmapP_ghost(east)
3931 do k=1,vlyr
3932 do i=1,npoints
3933 do j=1,nhc
3934 ir = npoints-i+1
3935 ghost%buf(ir,j,k,kptr,ie)=v(npoints-j,i, k)
3936 enddo
3937 enddo
3938 end do
3939 endif
3940
3941 if(desc%reverse(north)) then
3942 ! in = desc%putmapP_ghost(north)
3943 do k=1,vlyr
3944 do i=1,npoints
3945 do j=1,nhc
3946 ir = npoints-i+1
3947 ghost%buf(ir,j,k,kptr,in)=v(i,npoints-j, k)
3948 enddo
3949 enddo
3950 end do
3951 endif
3952
3953 if(desc%reverse(west)) then
3954 ! iw = desc%putmapP_ghost(west)
3955 do k=1,vlyr
3956 do i=1,npoints
3957 do j=1,nhc
3958 ir = npoints-i+1
3959 ghost%buf(ir,j,k,kptr,iw)=v(j+1,i, k)
3960 enddo
3961 enddo
3962 enddo
3963 endif
3964
3965 ! corners. this is difficult because we dont know the orientaton
3966 ! of the corners, and this which (i,j) dimension maps to which dimension
3967 ! SWEST
3968 do l=swest,swest+max_corner_elem-1
3969 if (l.ne.swest) call abortmp('ERROR3: swest ghost cell update requires ne>0 cubed-sphere mesh')
3970 if (desc%putmapP_ghost(l) /= -1) then
3971 do k=1,vlyr
3972 do i=1,nhc
3973 do j=1,nhc
3974 ghost%buf(i,j,k,kptr,desc%putmapP_ghost(l))=v(i+1,j+1,k)
3975 enddo
3976 enddo
3977 enddo
3978 end if
3979 end do
3980
3981 ! SEAST
3982 do l=swest+max_corner_elem,swest+2*max_corner_elem-1
3983 if (l.ne.seast) call abortmp('ERROR3: seast ghost cell update requires ne>0 cubed-sphere mesh')
3984 if (desc%putmapP_ghost(l) /= -1) then
3985 do k=1,vlyr
3986 do i=1,nhc
3987 do j=1,nhc
3988 ghost%buf(i,j,k,kptr,desc%putmapP_ghost(l))=v(npoints-i ,j+1,k)
3989 enddo
3990 enddo
3991 enddo
3992 end if
3993 end do
3994
3995 ! NEAST
3996 do l=swest+3*max_corner_elem,swest+4*max_corner_elem-1
3997 if (l.ne.neast) call abortmp('ERROR3: neast ghost cell update requires ne>0 cubed-sphere mesh')
3998 if (desc%putmapP_ghost(l) /= -1) then
3999 do k=1,vlyr
4000 do i=1,nhc
4001 do j=1,nhc
4002 ghost%buf(i,j,k,kptr,desc%putmapP_ghost(l))=v(npoints-i,npoints-j,k)
4003 enddo
4004 enddo
4005 enddo
4006 end if
4007 end do
4008
4009 ! NWEST
4010 do l=swest+2*max_corner_elem,swest+3*max_corner_elem-1
4011 if (l.ne.nwest) call abortmp('ERROR3: nwest ghost cell update requires ne>0 cubed-sphere mesh')
4012 if (desc%putmapP_ghost(l) /= -1) then
4013 do k=1,vlyr
4014 do i=1,nhc
4015 do j=1,nhc
4016 ghost%buf(i,j,k,kptr,desc%putmapP_ghost(l))=v(i+1,npoints-j,k)
4017 enddo
4018 enddo
4019 enddo
4020 end if
4021 end do
4022 end subroutine ghostVpack2d_level
4023
4024 ! =================================================================================
4025 ! GHOSTVUNPACK2D
4026 ! AUTHOR: Christoph Erath
4027 ! Unpack ghost points from ghost buffer into v...
4028 ! It is for cartesian points (v is only two dimensional).
4029 ! INPUT SAME arguments as for GHOSTVPACK2d
4030 ! =================================================================================
4031
4032 subroutine ghostVunpack2d_level(ghost,v,kptr,nhc,npoints,vlyr,desc)
4033 use dimensions_mod, only : max_corner_elem!, ntrac_d
4034 use control_mod, only : north, south, east, west, neast, nwest, seast, swest
4035 type (Ghostbuffertr_t), intent(in) :: ghost
4036
4037 integer, intent(in) :: nhc,npoints, vlyr,kptr
4038
4039 real (kind=real_kind), intent(inout) :: v(1-nhc:,1-nhc:,:)
4040 type (EdgeDescriptor_t) :: desc
4041
4042
4043 ! Local
4044 logical, parameter :: UseUnroll = .TRUE.
4045 integer :: i,j,l, itr, k
4046 integer :: is,ie,in,iw,ic
4047 logical :: reverse
4048
4049 threadsafe=.false.
4050
4051 is=desc%getmapP_ghost(south)
4052 ie=desc%getmapP_ghost(east)
4053 in=desc%getmapP_ghost(north)
4054 iw=desc%getmapP_ghost(west)
4055
4056 ! example for north buffer
4057 ! first row ('edge') goes in v(:,np+1)
4058 ! 2nd row ('edge') goes in v(:,np+2)
4059 ! etc...
4060 do k=1,vlyr
4061 do i=1,npoints
4062 do j=1,nhc
4063 v(i ,1-j, k) = ghost%buf(i,j,k,kptr,is )
4064 v(npoints+j ,i,k ) = ghost%buf(i,j,k,kptr,ie )
4065 v(i ,npoints+j,k) = ghost%buf(i,j,k,kptr,in )
4066 v(1-j ,i,k) = ghost%buf(i,j,k,kptr,iw )
4067 end do
4068 end do
4069 end do
4070
4071! SWEST
4072 do l=swest,swest+max_corner_elem-1
4073 ic = desc%getmapP_ghost(l)
4074 if(ic /= -1) then
4075 reverse=desc%reverse(l)
4076 if (reverse) then
4077 do k=1,vlyr
4078 do j=1,nhc
4079 do i=1,nhc
4080 v(1-i,1-j,k)=ghost%buf(j,i,k,kptr,ic)
4081 enddo
4082 enddo
4083 enddo
4084 else
4085 do k=1,vlyr
4086 do j=1,nhc
4087 do i=1,nhc
4088 v(1-i,1-j,k)=ghost%buf(i,j,k,kptr,ic)
4089 enddo
4090 enddo
4091 enddo
4092 endif
4093 else
4094 do k=1,vlyr
4095 do j=1,nhc
4096 do i=1,nhc
4097 v(1-i,1-j,k)=edgeDefaultVal
4098 enddo
4099 enddo
4100 enddo
4101 endif
4102 end do
4103
4104! SEAST
4105 do l=swest+max_corner_elem,swest+2*max_corner_elem-1
4106 ic = desc%getmapP_ghost(l)
4107 if(ic /= -1) then
4108 reverse=desc%reverse(l)
4109 if (reverse) then
4110 do k=1,vlyr
4111 do j=1,nhc
4112 do i=1,nhc
4113 v(npoints+i,1-j,k)=ghost%buf(j,i,k,kptr,ic)
4114 enddo
4115 enddo
4116 enddo
4117 else
4118 do k=1,vlyr
4119 do j=1,nhc
4120 do i=1,nhc
4121 v(npoints+i ,1-j,k)=ghost%buf(i,j,k,kptr,ic)
4122 enddo
4123 enddo
4124 enddo
4125 endif
4126 else
4127 do k=1,vlyr
4128 do j=1,nhc
4129 do i=1,nhc
4130 v(npoints+i ,1-j,k)=edgeDefaultVal
4131 enddo
4132 enddo
4133 enddo
4134 endif
4135 end do
4136
4137
4138! NEAST
4139 do l=swest+3*max_corner_elem,swest+4*max_corner_elem-1
4140 ic = desc%getmapP_ghost(l)
4141
4142 if(ic /= -1) then
4143 reverse=desc%reverse(l)
4144 if (reverse) then
4145 do k=1,vlyr
4146 do j=1,nhc
4147 do i=1,nhc
4148 v(npoints+i ,npoints+j,k)=ghost%buf(j,i,k,kptr,ic)
4149 enddo
4150 enddo
4151 enddo
4152 else
4153 do k=1,vlyr
4154 do j=1,nhc
4155 do i=1,nhc
4156 v(npoints+i ,npoints+j,k)=ghost%buf(i,j,k,kptr,ic)
4157 enddo
4158 enddo
4159 enddo
4160 endif
4161 else
4162 do k=1,vlyr
4163 do j=1,nhc
4164 do i=1,nhc
4165 v(npoints+i ,npoints+j,k)=edgeDefaultVal
4166 enddo
4167 enddo
4168 enddo
4169 endif
4170 end do
4171
4172! NWEST
4173 do l=swest+2*max_corner_elem,swest+3*max_corner_elem-1
4174 ic = desc%getmapP_ghost(l)
4175
4176 if(ic /= -1) then
4177 reverse=desc%reverse(l)
4178 if (reverse) then
4179 do k=1,vlyr
4180 do j=1,nhc
4181 do i=1,nhc
4182 v(1-i ,npoints+j,k)=ghost%buf(j,i,k,kptr,ic)
4183 enddo
4184 enddo
4185 enddo
4186 else
4187 do k=1,vlyr
4188 do j=1,nhc
4189 do i=1,nhc
4190 v(1-i ,npoints+j,k)=ghost%buf(i,j,k,kptr,ic)
4191 enddo
4192 enddo
4193 enddo
4194 endif
4195 else
4196 do k=1,vlyr
4197 do j=1,nhc
4198 do i=1,nhc
4199 v(1-i ,npoints+j,k)=edgeDefaultVal
4200 enddo
4201 enddo
4202 enddo
4203 endif
4204 end do
4205
4206 end subroutine ghostVunpack2d_level

4210 ! =================================================================================
4211 ! GHOSTVPACK2D
4212 ! AUTHOR: Christoph Erath
4213 ! Pack edges of v into an ghost buffer for boundary exchange.
4214 !
4215 ! This subroutine packs for one vertical layers into an ghost
4216 ! buffer. It is for cartesian points (v is only two dimensional).
4217 ! If the buffer associated with edge is not large enough to
4218 ! hold all vertical layers you intent to pack, the method will
4219 ! halt the program with a call to parallel_mod::haltmp().
4220 ! INPUT:
4221 ! - ghost Buffer into which the data will be packed.
4222 ! This buffer must be previously allocated with initGhostBuffer().
4223 ! - v The data to be packed.
4224 ! - nhc deep of ghost/halo zone
4225 ! - npoints number of points on on side
4226 ! - kptr Vertical pointer to the place in the edge buffer where
4227 ! data will be located.
4228 ! =================================================================================
4229 subroutine ghostVpack2d_single(ghost,v,nhc, npoints,desc)
4230 use dimensions_mod, only : max_corner_elem!, ntrac_d
4231 use control_mod, only : north, south, east, west, neast, nwest, seast, swest
4232
4233 type (Ghostbuffertr_t) :: ghost
4234 integer, intent(in) :: nhc,npoints
4235
4236 real (kind=real_kind),intent(in) :: v(1-nhc:npoints+nhc,1-nhc:npoints+nhc)
4237 type (EdgeDescriptor_t),intent(in) :: desc
4238
4239 ! Local variables
4240 integer :: i,j,ir,l,e
4241 integer :: itr,k
4242 integer :: is,ie,in,iw
4243
4244
4245 if(.not. threadsafe) then
4246 !$OMP BARRIER
4247 threadsafe=.true.
4248 end if
4249 ! Example convenction for buffer to the north:
4250 ! buf(:,,:,i,e)
4251 ! each "edge" is a row of data (i=1,np) in the element
4252 ! north most row of data goes into e=1
4253 ! next row of data goes into e=2
4254 ! ....
4255 ! south most row of data goes into e=np
4256 ! We need to pack this way to preserve the orientation
4257 ! so the data can be unpacked correctly
4258
4259 ! note: we think of buf as dimensioned buf(k,is,i,e)
4260 ! but this array is flatted to: buf(k,is+(i-1)+(e-1)*np)
4261 !
4262 is = desc%putmapP_ghost(south)
4263 ie = desc%putmapP_ghost(east)
4264 in = desc%putmapP_ghost(north)
4265 iw = desc%putmapP_ghost(west)
4266
4267 do i=1,npoints
4268 do j=1,nhc
4269 ghost%buf(i,j,1,1,is) = v(i ,j+1)
4270 ghost%buf(i,j,1,1,ie) = v(npoints-j,i)
4271 ghost%buf(i,j,1,1,in) = v(i ,npoints-j)
4272 ghost%buf(i,j,1,1,iw) = v(j+1,i)
4273 enddo
4274 end do
4275
4276 ! This is really kludgy way to setup the index reversals
4277 ! But since it is so a rare event not real need to spend time optimizing
4278 ! Check if the edge orientation of the recieving element is different
4279 ! if it is, swap the order of data in the edge
4280 if(desc%reverse(south)) then
4281 ! is = desc%putmapP_ghost(south)
4282 do i=1,npoints
4283 do j=1,nhc
4284 ir = npoints-i+1
4285 ghost%buf(ir,j,1,1,is)=v(i,j+1)
4286 enddo
4287 enddo
4288 endif
4289
4290 if(desc%reverse(east)) then
4291 ! ie = desc%putmapP_ghost(east)
4292 do i=1,npoints
4293 do j=1,nhc
4294 ir = npoints-i+1
4295 ghost%buf(ir,j,1,1,ie)=v(npoints-j,i)
4296 enddo
4297 enddo
4298 endif
4299
4300 if(desc%reverse(north)) then
4301 ! in = desc%putmapP_ghost(north)
4302 do i=1,npoints
4303 do j=1,nhc
4304 ir = npoints-i+1
4305 ghost%buf(ir,j,1,1,in)=v(i,npoints-j)
4306 enddo
4307 enddo
4308 endif
4309
4310 if(desc%reverse(west)) then
4311 ! iw = desc%putmapP_ghost(west)
4312 do i=1,npoints
4313 do j=1,nhc
4314 ir = npoints-i+1
4315 ghost%buf(ir,j,1,1,iw)=v(j+1,i)
4316 enddo
4317 enddo
4318 endif
4319
4320 ! corners. this is difficult because we dont know the orientaton
4321 ! of the corners, and this which (i,j) dimension maps to which dimension
4322 ! SWEST
4323 do l=swest,swest+max_corner_elem-1
4324 if (l.ne.swest) call abortmp('ERROR3: swest ghost cell update requires ne>0 cubed-sphere mesh')
4325 if (desc%putmapP_ghost(l) /= -1) then
4326 do i=1,nhc
4327 do j=1,nhc
4328 ghost%buf(i,j,1,1,desc%putmapP_ghost(l))=v(i+1,j+1)
4329 enddo
4330 enddo
4331 end if
4332 end do
4333
4334 ! SEAST
4335 do l=swest+max_corner_elem,swest+2*max_corner_elem-1
4336 if (l.ne.seast) call abortmp('ERROR3: seast ghost cell update requires ne>0 cubed-sphere mesh')
4337 if (desc%putmapP_ghost(l) /= -1) then
4338 do i=1,nhc
4339 do j=1,nhc
4340 ghost%buf(i,j,1,1,desc%putmapP_ghost(l))=v(npoints-i ,j+1)
4341 enddo
4342 enddo
4343 end if
4344 end do
4345
4346 ! NEAST
4347 do l=swest+3*max_corner_elem,swest+4*max_corner_elem-1
4348 if (l.ne.neast) call abortmp('ERROR3: neast ghost cell update requires ne>0 cubed-sphere mesh')
4349 if (desc%putmapP_ghost(l) /= -1) then
4350 do i=1,nhc
4351 do j=1,nhc
4352 ghost%buf(i,j,1,1,desc%putmapP_ghost(l))=v(npoints-i,npoints-j)
4353 enddo
4354 enddo
4355 end if
4356 end do
4357
4358 ! NWEST
4359 do l=swest+2*max_corner_elem,swest+3*max_corner_elem-1
4360 if (l.ne.nwest) call abortmp('ERROR3: nwest ghost cell update requires ne>0 cubed-sphere mesh')
4361 if (desc%putmapP_ghost(l) /= -1) then
4362 do i=1,nhc
4363 do j=1,nhc
4364 ghost%buf(i,j,1,1,desc%putmapP_ghost(l))=v(i+1,npoints-j)
4365 enddo
4366 enddo
4367 end if
4368 end do
4369 end subroutine ghostVpack2d_single
