4371 ! =================================================================================
4372 ! GHOSTVUNPACK2D
4373 ! AUTHOR: Christoph Erath
4374 ! Unpack ghost points from ghost buffer into v...
4375 ! It is for cartesian points (v is only two dimensional).
4376 ! INPUT SAME arguments as for GHOSTVPACK2d
4377 ! =================================================================================
4378
4379 subroutine ghostVunpack2d_single(ghost,v,nhc,npoints,desc)
4380 use dimensions_mod, only : max_corner_elem!, ntrac_d
4381 use control_mod, only : north, south, east, west, neast, nwest, seast, swest
4382 type (Ghostbuffertr_t), intent(in) :: ghost
4383
4384 integer, intent(in) :: nhc,npoints
4385
4386 real (kind=real_kind), intent(inout) :: v(1-nhc:npoints+nhc,1-nhc:npoints+nhc)
4387 type (EdgeDescriptor_t) :: desc
4388
4389
4390 ! Local
4391 logical, parameter :: UseUnroll = .TRUE.
4392 integer :: i,j,l, itr, k
4393 integer :: is,ie,in,iw,ic
4394 logical :: reverse
4395
4396 threadsafe=.false.
4397
4398 is=desc%getmapP_ghost(south)
4399 ie=desc%getmapP_ghost(east)
4400 in=desc%getmapP_ghost(north)
4401 iw=desc%getmapP_ghost(west)
4402
4403 ! example for north buffer
4404 ! first row ('edge') goes in v(:,np+1)
4405 ! 2nd row ('edge') goes in v(:,np+2)
4406 ! etc...
4407 do i=1,npoints
4408 do j=1,nhc
4409 v(i ,1-j) = ghost%buf(i,j,1,1,is )
4410 v(npoints+j ,i) = ghost%buf(i,j,1,1,ie )
4411 v(i ,npoints+j) = ghost%buf(i,j,1,1,in )
4412 v(1-j ,i) = ghost%buf(i,j,1,1,iw )
4413 end do
4414 end do
4415
4416! SWEST
4417 do l=swest,swest+max_corner_elem-1
4418 ic = desc%getmapP_ghost(l)
4419 if(ic /= -1) then
4420 reverse=desc%reverse(l)
4421 if (reverse) then
4422 do j=1,nhc
4423 do i=1,nhc
4424 v(1-i,1-j)=ghost%buf(j,i,1,1,ic)
4425 enddo
4426 enddo
4427 else
4428 do j=1,nhc
4429 do i=1,nhc
4430 v(1-i,1-j)=ghost%buf(i,j,1,1,ic)
4431 enddo
4432 enddo
4433 endif
4434 else
4435 do j=1,nhc
4436 do i=1,nhc
4437 v(1-i,1-j)=edgeDefaultVal
4438 enddo
4439 enddo
4440 endif
4441 end do
4442
4443! SEAST
4444 do l=swest+max_corner_elem,swest+2*max_corner_elem-1
4445 ic = desc%getmapP_ghost(l)
4446 if(ic /= -1) then
4447 reverse=desc%reverse(l)
4448 if (reverse) then
4449 do j=1,nhc
4450 do i=1,nhc
4451 v(npoints+i,1-j)=ghost%buf(j,i,1,1,ic)
4452 enddo
4453 enddo
4454 else
4455 do j=1,nhc
4456 do i=1,nhc
4457 v(npoints+i ,1-j)=ghost%buf(i,j,1,1,ic)
4458 enddo
4459 enddo
4460 endif
4461 else
4462 do j=1,nhc
4463 do i=1,nhc
4464 v(npoints+i ,1-j)=edgeDefaultVal
4465 enddo
4466 enddo
4467 endif
4468 end do
4469
4470
4471! NEAST
4472 do l=swest+3*max_corner_elem,swest+4*max_corner_elem-1
4473 ic = desc%getmapP_ghost(l)
4474
4475 if(ic /= -1) then
4476 reverse=desc%reverse(l)
4477 if (reverse) then
4478 do j=1,nhc
4479 do i=1,nhc
4480 v(npoints+i ,npoints+j)=ghost%buf(j,i,1,1,ic)
4481 enddo
4482 enddo
4483 else
4484 do j=1,nhc
4485 do i=1,nhc
4486 v(npoints+i ,npoints+j)=ghost%buf(i,j,1,1,ic)
4487 enddo
4488 enddo
4489 endif
4490 else
4491 do j=1,nhc
4492 do i=1,nhc
4493 v(npoints+i ,npoints+j)=edgeDefaultVal
4494 enddo
4495 enddo
4496 endif
4497 end do
4498
4499! NWEST
4500 do l=swest+2*max_corner_elem,swest+3*max_corner_elem-1
4501 ic = desc%getmapP_ghost(l)
4502
4503 if(ic /= -1) then
4504 reverse=desc%reverse(l)
4505 if (reverse) then
4506 do j=1,nhc
4507 do i=1,nhc
4508 v(1-i ,npoints+j)=ghost%buf(j,i,1,1,ic)
4509 enddo
4510 enddo
4511 else
4512 do j=1,nhc
4513 do i=1,nhc
4514 v(1-i ,npoints+j)=ghost%buf(i,j,1,1,ic)
4515 enddo
4516 enddo
4517 endif
4518 else
4519 do j=1,nhc
4520 do i=1,nhc
4521 v(1-i ,npoints+j)=edgeDefaultVal
4522 enddo
4523 enddo
4524 endif
4525 end do
4526
4527 end subroutine ghostVunpack2d_single

4534 ! =========================================
4535 ! initGhostBuffer3d:
4536 ! Author: James Overfelt
4537 ! create an Real based communication buffer
4538 ! npoints is the number of points on one side
4539 ! nhc is the deep of the ghost/halo zone
4540 ! =========================================
4541 subroutine initGhostBuffer3d(ghost,nlyr,np,nhc_in)
4542
4543 implicit none
4544 integer,intent(in) :: nlyr, np
4545 integer,intent(in),optional :: nhc_in
4546 type (Ghostbuffer3d_t),intent(out) :: ghost
4547
4548 ! Local variables
4549
4550 integer :: nbuf,nhc,i
4551
4552 ! sanity check for threading
4553 if (omp_get_num_threads()>1) then
4554 call haltmp('ERROR: initGhostBuffer must be called before threaded region')
4555 endif
4556
4557 if (present(nhc_in)) then
4558 nhc=nhc_in
4559 else
4560 nhc = np-1
4561 endif
4562
4563 nbuf=max_neigh_edges*nelemd
4564
4565 ghost%nlyr = nlyr
4566 ghost%nhc = nhc
4567 ghost%np = np
4568 ghost%nbuf = nbuf
4569 ghost%elem_size = np*(nhc+1)
4570 allocate(ghost%buf (np,(nhc+1),nlyr,nbuf))
4571 allocate(ghost%receive(np,(nhc+1),nlyr,nbuf))
4572 ghost%buf=0
4573 ghost%receive=0
4574
4575
4576
4577
4578 end subroutine initGhostBuffer3d

4582 ! =================================================================================
4583 ! GHOSTVPACK3D
4584 ! AUTHOR: James Overfelt (from a subroutine of Christoph Erath, ghostvpack2D)
4585 ! Pack edges of v into an ghost buffer for boundary exchange.
4586 !
4587 ! This subroutine packs for many vertical layers into an ghost
4588 ! buffer.
4589 ! If the buffer associated with edge is not large enough to
4590 ! hold all vertical layers you intent to pack, the method will
4591 ! halt the program with a call to parallel_mod::haltmp().
4592 ! INPUT:
4593 ! - ghost Buffer into which the data will be packed.
4594 ! This buffer must be previously allocated with initGhostBuffer().
4595 ! - v The data to be packed.
4596 ! - nhc deep of ghost/halo zone
4597 ! - npoints number of points on on side
4598 ! - kptr Vertical pointer to the place in the edge buffer where
4599 ! data will be located.
4600 ! =================================================================================
4601 subroutine ghostVpack3d(ghost, v, vlyr, kptr, desc)
4602 use dimensions_mod, only : max_corner_elem
4603 use control_mod, only : north, south, east, west, neast, nwest, seast, swest
4604 use edgetype_mod, only : edgedescriptor_t, ghostbuffer3d_t
4605 implicit none
4606
4607 type (Ghostbuffer3d_t) :: ghost
4608 integer, intent(in) :: kptr,vlyr
4609 real (kind=real_kind),intent(in) :: v(ghost%np, ghost%np, vlyr)
4610 type (EdgeDescriptor_t),intent(in) :: desc
4611
4612 integer :: nhc, np
4613
4614 ! Local variables
4615 integer :: i,j,k,ir,l,e
4616
4617 integer :: is,ie,in,iw
4618
4619 if(.not. threadsafe) then
4620!$OMP BARRIER
4621 threadsafe=.true.
4622 end if
4623 ! Example convenction for buffer to the north:
4624 ! buf(:,,:,i,e)
4625 ! each "edge" is a row of data (i=1,np) in the element
4626 ! north most row of data goes into e=1
4627 ! next row of data goes into e=2
4628 ! ....
4629 ! south most row of data goes into e=np
4630 ! We need to pack this way to preserve the orientation
4631 ! so the data can be unpacked correctly
4632
4633 ! note: we think of buf as dimensioned buf(k,is,i,e)
4634 ! but this array is flatted to: buf(k,is+(i-1)+(e-1)*np)
4635 !
4636 nhc = ghost%nhc
4637 np = ghost%np
4638 is = desc%putmapP_ghost(south)
4639 ie = desc%putmapP_ghost(east)
4640 in = desc%putmapP_ghost(north)
4641 iw = desc%putmapP_ghost(west)
4642
4643 do k=1,vlyr
4644 do j=1,nhc
4645 do i=1,np
4646 ghost%buf(i,j,kptr+k,is) = v(i, j+1 , k)
4647 ghost%buf(i,j,kptr+k,ie) = v(np-j, i , k)
4648 ghost%buf(i,j,kptr+k,in) = v(i, np-j , k)
4649 ghost%buf(i,j,kptr+k,iw) = v(j+1, i , k)
4650 enddo
4651 end do
4652 end do
4653 ! This is really kludgy way to setup the index reversals
4654 ! But since it is so a rare event not real need to spend time optimizing
4655 ! Check if the edge orientation of the recieving element is different
4656 ! if it is, swap the order of data in the edge
4657 if(desc%reverse(south)) then
4658 do k=1,vlyr
4659 do j=1,nhc
4660 do i=1,np
4661 ir = np-i+1
4662 ghost%buf(ir, j, kptr+k, is)=v(i, j+1, k)
4663 enddo
4664 enddo
4665 enddo
4666 endif
4667
4668 if(desc%reverse(east)) then
4669 do k=1,vlyr
4670 do j=1,nhc
4671 do i=1,np
4672 ir = np-i+1
4673 ghost%buf(ir, j, kptr+k, ie)=v(np-j, i, k)
4674 enddo
4675 enddo
4676 enddo
4677 endif
4678
4679 if(desc%reverse(north)) then
4680 do k=1,vlyr
4681 do j=1,nhc
4682 do i=1,np
4683 ir = np-i+1
4684 ghost%buf(ir, j, kptr+k, in)=v(i, np-j, k)
4685 enddo
4686 enddo
4687 enddo
4688 endif
4689
4690 if(desc%reverse(west)) then
4691 do k=1,vlyr
4692 do j=1,nhc
4693 do i=1,np
4694 ir = np-i+1
4695 ghost%buf(ir, j, kptr+k, iw)=v(j+1, i, k)
4696 enddo
4697 enddo
4698 enddo
4699 endif
4700
4701 ! corners. this is difficult because we dont know the orientaton
4702 ! of the corners, and this which (i,j) dimension maps to which dimension
4703! SWEST
4704 do l=swest, swest+max_corner_elem-1
4705 if (desc%putmapP_ghost(l) /= -1) then
4706 do k=1,vlyr
4707 do j=1,nhc+1
4708 do i=1,nhc+1
4709 ghost%buf(i, j, kptr+k, desc%putmapP_ghost(l))=v(i, j, k)
4710 enddo
4711 enddo
4712 enddo
4713 end if
4714 end do
4715
4716! SEAST
4717 do l=swest+max_corner_elem,swest+2*max_corner_elem-1
4718 if (desc%putmapP_ghost(l) /= -1) then
4719 do k=1,vlyr
4720 do j=1,nhc+1
4721 do i=1,nhc+1
4722 ghost%buf(i, j, kptr+k, desc%putmapP_ghost(l))=v(np-i+1, j, k)
4723 enddo
4724 enddo
4725 enddo
4726 end if
4727 end do
4728
4729! NEAST
4730 do l=swest+3*max_corner_elem,swest+4*max_corner_elem-1
4731 if (desc%putmapP_ghost(l) /= -1) then
4732 do k=1,vlyr
4733 do j=1,nhc+1
4734 do i=1,nhc+1
4735 ghost%buf(i, j, kptr+k,desc%putmapP_ghost(l))=v(np-i+1, np-j+1, k)
4736 enddo
4737 enddo
4738 enddo
4739 end if
4740 end do
4741
4742! NWEST
4743 do l=swest+2*max_corner_elem,swest+3*max_corner_elem-1
4744 if (desc%putmapP_ghost(l) /= -1) then
4745 do k=1,vlyr
4746 do j=1,nhc+1
4747 do i=1,nhc+1
4748 ghost%buf(i, j, kptr+k,desc%putmapP_ghost(l))=v(i, np-j+1, k)
4749 enddo
4750 enddo
4751 enddo
4752 end if
4753 end do
4754 end subroutine ghostVpack3d

4756 ! =================================================================================
4757 ! GHOSTVUNPACK3D
4758 ! AUTHOR: James Overfelt (from a subroutine of Christoph Erath, ghostVunpack2d)
4759 ! Unpack ghost points from ghost buffer into v...
4760 ! It is for cartesian points (v is only two dimensional).
4761 ! INPUT SAME arguments as for GHOSTVPACK
4762 ! =================================================================================
4763
4764 subroutine ghostVunpack3d(g, v, vlyr, kptr, desc, sw, se, nw, ne, mult)
4765 use dimensions_mod, only : max_corner_elem
4766 use control_mod, only : north, south, east, west, neast, nwest, seast, swest
4767 use edgetype_mod, only : edgedescriptor_t, ghostbuffer3d_t
4768 implicit none
4769 type (Ghostbuffer3d_t), intent(in) :: g
4770
4771 integer, intent(in) :: kptr,vlyr
4772 real (kind=real_kind), intent(inout) :: v (1-g%nhc : g%np+g%nhc, 1-g%nhc : g%np+g%nhc, vlyr)
4773 integer, intent(out) :: mult(5:8)
4774 real (kind=real_kind), intent(out) :: sw(1-g%nhc : 1, 1-g%nhc : 1, vlyr, max_corner_elem-1)
4775 real (kind=real_kind), intent(out) :: se( g%np : g%np+g%nhc, 1-g%nhc : 1, vlyr, max_corner_elem-1)
4776 real (kind=real_kind), intent(out) :: ne( g%np : g%np+g%nhc, g%np : g%np+g%nhc, vlyr, max_corner_elem-1)
4777 real (kind=real_kind), intent(out) :: nw(1-g%nhc : 1, g%np : g%np+g%nhc, vlyr, max_corner_elem-1)
4778 type (EdgeDescriptor_t) :: desc
4779
4780 integer :: nhc, np
4781
4782 ! Local
4783 logical, parameter :: UseUnroll = .TRUE.
4784 integer :: i,j,k,l
4785 integer :: is,ie,in,iw,ic
4786 logical :: reverse
4787
4788 threadsafe=.false.
4789
4790 nhc = g%nhc
4791 np = g%np
4792
4793 is=desc%getmapP_ghost(south)
4794 ie=desc%getmapP_ghost(east)
4795 in=desc%getmapP_ghost(north)

4871 enddo
4872 enddo

4909 enddo

4911 else

4917 enddo
